It was as if you sent many flashes of lightning that made my enemies so afraid that they ran away in different directions, as if you had shot arrows at them.
The bottom of the ocean became visible, and the water uncovered the foundations of the earth when Yahweh rebuked his enemies with the breath that came in his anger!
It was as if you reached down from heaven and grabbed me so that you could pull me up out of the deep water of the ocean.
There was a powerful man who wanted to harm me, and there were people who hated me. They were too strong for me to defeat, but you rescued me from them.
They attacked me, and they would have destroyed me, but you, Yahweh, protected me.
You brought me to a place where I was safe. You love me, and so you rescued me.
Yahweh, you did good things for me because I did what was right. I did not harm my enemies, so you made sure that they did not harm me.
Yahweh, I have lived as you want people to live. I have not stopped obeying you, my God, and done wicked things instead.
I have remained aware of what you have said people should do, and I have continued to obey all your laws.
I have not done anything for which you would blame me. I have been careful not to do anything for which you would punish me.
You have done good things for me because I did what is right. You recognize that I am innocent.
When people are loyal to you, you act loyally toward them; when people are careful to do what you want them to do, you do good things for them.
You allow sincere people to recognize how sincere you are. But when people try to trick others, you show that you are much more clever than they are.
You rescue people whom others are afflicting, but you humiliate those who are proud.
Yahweh my God, it is as if you light my lamp so that I can see even when it is dark.
With your help I have caught and defeated a band of raiders. With your help I have captured a city that had walls around it, as if I had leaped over those walls.
My God, everything that you do is perfect. Everything that you say is right. You protect everyone who depends on you, as if you are a shield that defends them.
Yahweh, you are the only real God. Only you are like a huge rock {where I can go to be safe}.
My God, you enable me to be strong like someone who equips me for war. You make sure that nothing prevents me from doing what you want me to do.
You enable me to walk about safely in the mountains, as a deer does, without falling.
You teach me how to fight in a battle. You give me the strength to bend {and string} a bronze bow.
You have saved me by protecting me like a shield, you are strong and therefore keep me safe. You humble yourself and answer my prayers and this is what has made me successful.
You have given me many ways to respond to each situation. As a result, I have been able to carry out my plans successfully.
I chased my enemies and defeated them. I did not stop fighting them until I had killed them all.
I wounded them so badly that the ones who fell to the ground never got up because they died of their wounds.
You have given me the strength and courage to fight battles. When people revolted against me, you enabled me to subdue them.
You enabled me to defeat my enemies and step in triumph on their necks. You gave me power over those who hated me so that I was able to destroy them.
They called out for someone to rescue them, but no one did. They cried out {for help} to you, Yahweh, but you did not help them.

I defeated them so completely that they were no longer any threat to me, no more than tiny particles of dust that the wind blows away would be. It was as if they were dirt that I threw out into the street.
You rescued me from the Israelites who tried to rebel against me. You appointed me as the ruler of many nations. Foreign people are now my subjects.
When they heard about what Yahweh enabled me to do, they obeyed me. Foreign rulers fearfully bow down in front of me {to show their submission}.
I defeat foreign armies that resist me so that they become weak, like a plant that dries up in the sun. They surrender and come out of their walled cities shaking with weakness and fear.
Yahweh, you are the only real God! I praise you! You are like a huge rock {where I can go to be safe}! You are the God who rescues me. Everyone should exalt you.
You are the God who enables me to conquer enemies who have attacked me. You cause the people of other nations to be subject to my rule.

You kept my enemies from capturing me. People rebelled against me, but it as if their armies had been floodwaters and you lifted me out of them to safety. You rescued me from men who tried to harm me.
Because of all this, I thank you, Yahweh, so that all people groups will know that you are the one who has helped me. I will sing to praise you for what you have done that has made you famous.
You chose me to be king, and you have done great things to save me from my enemies. You faithfully show kindness to me, David, whom you anointed as king, as well as to my descendants forever.”
{When people look at everything that} God {has placed} in the skies, they can see that he is very great. Yes, the way God made the sky shows people that he is powerful.
Day after day {it is as though the sun} proclaims the glory of God, and night after night {it is as though the moon and stars} say that God made them.
They do not really speak; they do not say any words. There is no sound from them for anyone to hear.
But what they declare {about God} goes throughout all the world, and {even people who live in} the most distant places on earth can know it. The sun is in the skies where God placed it;
it rises each morning like a bridegroom {who is happy} as he comes out of his bedroom after his wedding. It is like a strong athlete who is very eager to start running in a race.
The sun rises at one side of the sky and goes across the sky and sets on the other side, and there is nothing that is unaffected by its heat.

The instructions that Yahweh has given us are perfect; they keep us from living in a way that would cause God to condemn us. We can be sure that the things that Yahweh has told us are trustworthy, and by learning them people who have not been previously taught will become wise.
Yahweh’s laws are fair; {when we obey them,} we become joyful. The commands of Yahweh are morally perfect, and {by learning them} we start to understand {how God wants us to behave}.

The law of Yahweh causes people to revere him and therefore live in a morally upright way; that is something that will endure forever. The things Yahweh has decreed are true, they are completely righteous.

Yahweh’s commandments are more valuable than gold, even great amounts of the purest gold. Learning the things Yahweh teaches us through them is more pleasurable than eating honey, than honey dripping from honeycombs.
Furthermore, by your commandments I am warned {about what things I should not do}. You greatly reward those who obey them.
There is no one who can know all his sins; so Yahweh, forgive me for these things which I do that I do not realize are wrong.
Also, keep me from doing things that I know are wrong; do not let my sinful desires control me. If you do that, then I will be guiltless, and I will not be guilty of committing any great sin.
I pray that both what I say, and what I think about, be pleasing to you, Yahweh, you who enable me to be strong and who redeem me.
I desire that Yahweh will answer you {when you call out to him} when you are in a crisis! I desire that Yahweh, the God whom {our ancestor} Jacob worshiped, will protect you {from your enemies}.
I desire that he may come from his sacred temple and help you, and aid you from {where he lives} on Mount Zion.
I desire that he may accept all your grain offerings and accept all your {other} offerings that you give him to be burned {on the altar}. Selah
I want him to give you what you desire, and I want him to allow you to be able to accomplish everything that you have planned to do.

When you defeat your enemies, we will shout joyfully. We will lift up a banner proclaiming that it is Yahweh our God {who helps us}. I desire Yahweh to do everything that you have requested him to do.
I know now that Yahweh rescues the one whom he has chosen {to be king}. From his holy place in heaven he will answer him, and he will save him by his great power.

Some {kings} trust that because they have chariots {they will be able to defeat their enemies}, and some trust that their horses {will enable them to defeat their enemies}, but we will trust in the power of Yahweh our God.
Some will stumble and fall down, but we will be strong and not be moved.
Yahweh, enable your king {to defeat our enemies}! We desire that the king answer us when we cry out {for help}.
Yahweh, {your} king is glad because you have enabled him to be strong and because you have rescued him {from his enemies}; indeed, how exceedingly he rejoices.
You have given {your} king the things he desired, and you have not refused to do what he requested you to do. Selah
In answer to his prayer, you bless him with many good things. You place a gold crown on his head.
He asked you to let him live for a long time, and you have enabled him to live for a long time.
People honor him greatly because you have helped him defeat his enemies. You have made him famous.
You bless him forever, and you cause him to be joyful in your presence.
The king trusts in you, Yahweh, and because you, who are much greater than all other spirit beings, faithfully love him, you will protect him.
You, the king, will defeat all your enemies; yes, you will surely defeat all those who hate you.

When you, the king, appear, you will so completely destroy them that it will be as if you threw them into a fiery furnace. Because Yahweh is angry with them, he will decimate them so completely that it will be as if he swallowed them whole or burned them up.
You, the king, will remove their children from this earth; their descendants will all disappear.
They want to harm you, but what they plan will never succeed.
You will cause them to run away by shooting arrows at them.
Yahweh, show everyone how very strong you are! {When you do that,} we will sing and praise you because you are very powerful.
My God, my God, why have you abandoned me? Why do you not come and help me? Why do you not respond to me when {I am suffering so severely that} I am groaning?
My God, every day I call to you during the daytime and during the night, but you do not answer me, so I am not able to sleep.
But you are holy. You sit on your throne as king, and receive praise in your sacred tent from your people Israel.
Our ancestors trusted in you. They trusted in you and you rescued them.
When they cried out to you for help, you saved them. They trusted in you, and they were not disappointed.
But you have not rescued me! People despise me and consider that I am not a man; they think that I am a worm! Everyone scorns me and despises me.
Everyone who sees me makes fun of me. They sneer at me and {insult me by} shaking their heads {at me}.
{My enemies say,} “He trusts in Yahweh, so Yahweh should save him! {He says that} Yahweh is very pleased with him; if that is so, Yahweh should rescue him!”
You, God, have been with me since I was in my mother’s womb, and you taught me to trust you when I was at my mother’s breasts.
It was as though you had adopted me right when I was born. You have been my God ever since I was born.
Come near to me {and help me,} because my enemies are near me and there is no one who is helping me.
My enemies surround me {like} a group of wild bulls. {Fierce people, like those} strong bulls that {graze on the hills} in {the region of} Bashan, surround me.

{They are like} roaring lions that are attacking the animals that they want to kill. They rush toward me to kill me; they {are like lions that} have their mouths open, ready to tear their victims to pieces.
I am completely exhausted, and am in much pain! I feel greatly discouraged!

My strength is all dried up like a broken piece of a clay jar that has dried {in the sun}. You have allowed {me to become so thirsty that} my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. {Oh God, I think that you are about to let} my body die and become dust!
My enemies surround me like a pack of wild dogs. A group of evil men has encircled me{, ready to attack me}. They have pierced my hands and my feet.
{I am so weak and thin that} I can see and count my bones. My enemies stare at me and gloat {about what has happened to} me.
{They looked at} the clothes that I {was wearing} and gambled to determine which piece each of them would get.
Yahweh, do not be like my enemies; rather be concerned for me. You who are the one who strengthens me, come quickly and help me.
Rescue me from {those who want to} kill me with their swords. Save me from those who are {like wild} dogs.
Snatch me away from my enemies who are like lions whose jaws {are already open}, ready to chew me up! Grab me away from those men who are like wild oxen {that attack other animals with} their horns!
{Because you have saved me,} I will proclaim to my fellow Israelites how great you are. I will praise you among the group of your people gathered together {to worship you}.
You people who have an awesome respect for Yahweh, praise him! All you who are descended from Jacob, honor Yahweh! All you Israelite people, revere him!
Yahweh does not despise or ignore those who are suffering. He pays attention to them, and he responds when they call out to him {for help}.

Yahweh, in the great gathering {of your people,} I will praise you for what you have done. In the presence of those who revere Yahweh, I will offer {the sacrifice} that I promised {to make to you because you delivered me}.
The poor people {whom I have invited to the meal} will eat as much as they want. All who come to worship Yahweh will praise him. I pray that {God will enable} you all to live a long and happy life!
People in all nations, even in the remote areas, will think about Yahweh and turn to him. People from all the clans in the world will bow down before you,
because Yahweh is the king! He rules the people of all nations.
All the rich people on the earth will celebrate and bow before him. All those who are close to dying will kneel in worship {before him}, yes, those who are not able to keep themselves alive.
People who have not been born yet will {also} serve Yahweh. We will tell our descendants what Yahweh {has done}.

People will come and will proclaim to people not yet born, {who will live in future years,} that because Yahweh is righteous {he has delivered those who prayed to him for help}. {People will tell them} that, “Yahweh did {it}!”
A psalm of David Yahweh {cares for} me {like} a shepherd {cares for his sheep}, {so} I {know that I} will have everything that I need.

Yahweh nourishes and encourages my inner person and enables me to rest in peace, like a shepherd who leads {his sheep} to places where there is plenty of green grass {for them to eat} and leads them to streams where the water is flowing slowly.
Yahweh renews my strength. He gives me good guidance for how I should live, in order that I, and others, will honor him.

Even when I am in dangerous and scary circumstances in which evil men might kill or hurt me, I will fear nothing, because you are with me. I feel comforted and reassured because you protect and care for me like a shepherd protects his sheep by using his club and his walking stick to protect them from being attacked by wild animals.

You {richly} provide food for me and protect me from my enemies. You joyfully welcome me and honor me as people joyfully receive the guests they have invited by pouring olive oil over their heads. You have given me very many blessings!
I am certain that Yahweh will be good to me and will continue to love me faithfully as long as I live. I will worship Yahweh in his sanctuary throughout my life.
A psalm of David The earth and everything in it belongs to Yahweh. All the people in the world belong to him too,
because he caused the ground to be above the water, above the water that was deep below the surface of the earth.
This is the type of person who Yahweh will allow to go up onto his mountain, Mount Zion {in Jerusalem}, in order to stand {and worship} him in his sacred tent.
Only those whose actions and thoughts are pure, who have not worshiped idols, and who do not tell lies when they have solemnly promised to speak truthfully.
Yahweh will bless this type of person. When Yahweh {judges them,} he who has saved them, he will say that they are righteous.
Such are the ones who seek Yahweh, the descendants of Jacob, who seek you, Yahweh. Selah
Open up the gates {of the sacred tent}, in order that our glorious king may enter!
I will tell you who this glorious king is. {He is} Yahweh, the one who is very strong; {He is} Yahweh, who conquers {all his enemies} in battles!
Open up the gates {of the sacred tent}, in order that our glorious king may enter!
I will tell you who he, this glorious king, is. {He is} Yahweh, who commands armies; he is our glorious king! Selah
A psalm of David Yahweh, I come to you in prayer and tell you all that I need.
I trust in you, my God. Do not allow my enemies {to defeat me}, with the result that they would rejoice and I would be ashamed.
Truly, you will not allow any of those who trust in you to be ashamed. You will cause those who act treacherously toward others to be ashamed.
Yahweh, show me how I should conduct my life as you want me to. Teach me how to act in the manner that is pleasing to you.
Teach me to conduct my life by obeying your truth, because you are my God, the one who saves me. I trust in you at all times.
Yahweh, please act mercifully to me and faithfully love me, because that is the way that you have acted since long ago.

Forgive me for the sinful things I did when I was young and for my rebellious actions {as an adult}. I ask that, because you faithfully love your people, you treat me kindly and forgive me. Yahweh, I ask that you do this because you are good!
Yahweh is good and acts righteously, so he shows sinful people the right way to conduct their lives.
He shows humble people what is right for them to do and teaches them what he wants them to do.
Yahweh always faithfully loves and does what he has promised to those who obey his covenant and who do what he requires.
Yahweh, forgive me for all my sins, which are many, in order that I and others may honor you.
To all those who revere Yahweh, he shows them the right way to conduct their lives.
They will always be prosperous, and their descendants will continue to live in {this} land.
Yahweh is a friend of those who revere him, and he teaches them the covenant that he made {with them}.
I always ask Yahweh to help me, because he will rescue me when my enemies attempt to hurt me.
{Yahweh,} pay attention to me and be merciful to me, because I have no one to help me and I am suffering.
{Because of my present circumstances} there are many things that cause me to worry. Rescue me from the things that are causing me to be distressed.
Take notice that I am in difficult circumstances and troubled, and forgive me for every sinful thing I have done.
Take notice that I have many enemies, and that they hate me very much.
Protect me and rescue me {from them}; do not allow {them to defeat me with the result that} I would be ashamed, because I go to you to keep me safe.
Protect me because I do what is good and honest, and because I trust in you.
God, rescue {us} Israelite people from all of our troubles!
A psalm of David Yahweh, show that I am innocent. I have done what is right, and I have trusted in Yahweh without doubting him.
Yahweh, examine what I have done and test me; thoroughly evaluate what I think in my inner being.
I never forget that you faithfully love me. I conduct my life according to what you say is right.
I do not spend my time with liars, and I stay away from hypocrites.
I do not like to be with evil people, and I avoid wicked people.
Yahweh, I wash my hands to show that I have not done what was wrong. As I join with others marching around your altar,
we sing songs to thank you, and we tell others the wonderful things that you have done.
Yahweh, I love {to be in} the sanctuary where you dwell, in the place where your glory appears.
Do not get rid of me like you get rid of sinners. Do not cause me to die like you cause those who murder people to die,
and people who are ready to do wicked things, and people who are always taking bribes.
But as for me, I always try to do what is right. So rescue me and act kindly toward me.
{Because I have conducted myself righteously} I am secure, and when all Yahweh’s people gather together, I praise him among them.
A psalm of David Yahweh encourages me and nourishes my inner being. He is the one who saves me, so I will not fear anyone. Yahweh is the one to whom I go for refuge, so I will not dread anyone.
When those who do evil things come near me to attack and destroy me, Yahweh enables me to defeat them so that they fall down.
Even if an army sets up their tents in order to attack me, I will not be afraid. Even if they attack me, I will trust {in God}.

There is one thing that I have requested from Yahweh, and that one thing I will repeatedly ask Yahweh for. {This is the one thing I ask of Yahweh}: that I may worship in Yahweh’s sanctuary every day during my life, in order to experience how wonderful Yahweh is. When I am in his sanctuary then I will ask him {for guidance}.

When I have troubles he will protect me in his tabernacle; yes, he will keep me safe in his sacred tent. He will keep me safe as if he were setting me high upon a rock {where my enemies cannot reach me}.
Then I will triumph over my enemies who surround me. I will shout joyfully as I offer sacrifices in his sacred tent, and I will praise Yahweh as I sing.
Yahweh, listen to me while I call {to you in prayer}. Act kindly toward me and answer my prayer.
{I sensed that I heard you say,} “Seek me and my help,” {so,} Yahweh, I will respond by seeking you and your help.
I am your servant; do not be angry with me, or turn away from me. You have always helped me. You are the one who has saved me, so do not abandon me now.
My father and mother have left me, but Yahweh will take care of me.
Yahweh, teach me to do what you want me to do, and guide me so that I remain safe because I have enemies {who want to hurt me}.
Do not allow my enemies to do to me what they want, because they say false things about me and want violent things to happen to me.
I would have died if I had not trusted you to be good to me as long as I live.
Trust in Yahweh. Have a strong and courageous attitude, and wait expectantly for Yahweh {to help you}.

A psalm of David Yahweh, I call out to you. You are like a huge rock {on top of which I am safe}. Do not refuse to answer me because if you refuse to answer me, I will soon be with those who are in their graves.
Pay attention to me and respond when I call out for you to help me when I pray, lifting up my hands as I face your very holy place in your sacred tent.
Do not get rid of me when you get rid of wicked people, those who do wicked deeds. Those people speak peacefully toward others, while in their inner beings, they hate them and devise evil plans.
Punish those people in the way that they deserve for what they have done; punish them for their evil deeds.

Yahweh will get rid of them permanently and not let them appear again. Yahweh {will do this} because these evil people do not pay attention to the righteous things he has taught his people and do not take notice that he always judges evil deeds.
Praise Yahweh because he responded to me when I called out for him to help me.
Yahweh strengthens me and he protects me like a shield; I trust in him, and he helps me. As a result I am glad in my inner being, and I will praise him with my songs {of praise}.
Yahweh strengthens and protects his people. Yahweh saves the one he appointed to be king.
Yahweh, rescue your people and bless those who belong to you. Take care of them like a shepherd takes care of his sheep; take care of them forever.
A psalm of David You heavenly beings, praise Yahweh! Declare that he is very glorious and powerful.
Proclaim that Yahweh is glorious. Bow down and worship Yahweh in holy attire.
{People hear} Yahweh’s voice above the sea; the glorious God thunders. Yahweh’s {voice thunders} over the large sea.
Yahweh’s voice is powerful and majestic.
The sound of Yahweh’s voice breaks cedar trees, the cedars that grow in Lebanon.
He causes {the mountains in} Lebanon to jump like calves jump, and he causes Mount Hermon to jump as a young wild bull jumps.
Yahweh tells the lightning to flash {upon the mountains} and it hews out rocks.
The sound of Yahweh’s voice causes the wilderness to shake; he shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The sound of Yahweh’s voice makes the deer give birth and strips the leaves from the trees, while the people in Yahweh’s sacred tent say, “Praise Yahweh!”
Yahweh rules as king over the waters that are above the sky; Yahweh rules as king forever.
Yahweh will strengthen his people, and he will bless them by giving them good things and causing them to be happy and peaceful.
Yahweh, I praise you because you rescued me. You did not allow {me to die with the result that} my enemies could gloat.
Yahweh my God, I called out for you to help me {when I was sick,} you healed me.
Yahweh, when I was dying you restored me. I was nearly dead, but you caused me to get well.
All you who are faithful to Yahweh, sing praise to him. Think about what Yahweh, the holy one, has done, and thank him.
When he becomes angry, he is angry for only a very short time, but he is good {to us} all of our lives. We may cry during the night, but the next morning we will be joyful.
As for me, when my life was going well, I said {to myself}, “Nothing will ever trouble me.”
Yahweh, because you were good to me, at first you caused me to be secure as a mountain. {But then you let me become ill when} you stopped protecting me {from illness}, and I became greatly disturbed.
{Then} I called out to you, Yahweh, and I pleaded for you, the Lord, to help me.

{I said,} “{Yahweh,} you will gain nothing if I die. It will not benefit you at all if I go to the place where the dead people are. Dead people certainly are not able to praise you, and they are not able to tell others that you are faithful.
Yahweh, listen to me, and act mercifully to me. Yahweh, help me.”

{But now} you have changed my circumstances and healed me, and as a result I have stopped grieving and now dance joyfully. You have caused me to change from the clothes that showed that I was very sad and to put on clothes that show that I am very joyful.
{You did that} so that I would not be silent but would sing out to praise you. Yahweh, you are my God, and I will thank you forever.
Yahweh, I come to you to protect me. Never allow {them to defeat me, with the result that} I would be ashamed. Since you always do what is right and just, please rescue me.
Respond to my prayers for help, and save me right now! Be {like} a huge rock where I can flee for refuge, and {like} a strong fortress in which my enemies cannot harm me.
{Yes,} you are {like} a huge rock and {like} a fortress {where I can go to be safe}. For the sake of your reputation you guide me {so that no harm comes to me}.
You are the one who protects me, so you will rescue me from the evil plans my enemies have secretly made to hurt me.
I put myself into your care. You have rescued me. Yahweh, you are faithful.
I hate those who worship useless idols, but I trust in Yahweh.
I will be very glad because you faithfully love me. You have noticed that I have suffered, and have known the troubling things I have experienced.
You have not allowed my enemies to capture me; instead, you brought me to a place where I was safe.
Yahweh, act kindly toward me because I am distressed. Because I cry so much that my eyes are tired, and I am completely exhausted.
I have become very weak because I am so miserable; my life is getting shorter. I have become weak because of the sinful things that I have done. I am totally exhausted.

All of my enemies make fun of me, and my neighbors, especially, despise me. My friends are afraid of me {because they think that you, God, are punishing me}. When they see me on the streets, they run away.
People have forgotten me like they forget people who are dead. I am {as useless as} a broken pot.
There are terrifying things all around me. I hear people whispering {things about me}. My enemies are making plans to kill me.
But Yahweh, I trust in you. I say {confidently} that you are the God I worship.
You control the events and circumstances of my life. Save me from my enemies, from those who pursue me.
Act kindly toward me and rescue me because you always faithfully love me.
Yahweh, I call out to you, so do not allow others to shame me. I desire that you cause wicked people to be ashamed. I desire that they {soon die and} go down to the place where the dead people are.
I desire that you will cause people who tell lies to be unable to speak. {Do that to} people who arrogantly say disrespectful things about righteous people.
Many indeed are the good things which you have prepared for the people who revere you! You do good things for those who go to you for protection. Everyone sees you protect them.
You protect people {who trust in you} by being near to them and saving them from people who devise evil schemes {to harm them}. You keep them safe from their enemies who accuse them.
Praise Yahweh! When my enemies surrounded the city {in which I was living,} he showed me in a wonderful way that he faithfully loves me.
I was alarmed and cried out, “I have been separated from Yahweh!” But in fact you heard me {and answered} my cry for help.
You people who belong to Yahweh, love him! Those who are loyal to him, he protects, but those who are proud, he punishes them severely like they deserve to be punished.
You who confidently expect Yahweh {to do great things for you,} be strong and be courageous!
A song of David Those whom God has forgiven for rebelling against him, and those whose sin God has atoned for, these are the ones who will have a truly good life!
Those whose record of sins Yahweh no longer takes into account, and those who are not deceitful, these are the ones who will have a truly good life!
When I did not confess my sins, my body felt weak and sick, and I groaned all day long.
Day and night, Yahweh, you afflicted me. My strength was sapped like it would be on a hot summer day. Selah

{Then} I confessed my sinful actions to you; I stopped trying to hide them. I said to myself, “I will tell Yahweh the wrong things that I have done.” When I confessed them, you forgave me, so now I am no longer guilty for the sinful things I did. Selah
Therefore all the people who are godly should pray to you when they realize they have sinned. {If they do that,} then it is certain that difficulties will not overwhelm them like a great flood.
You are like a place where I can hide from my enemies; you protect me from troubles and surround me with people who are joyfully praising you for saving me from my enemies. Selah
I will teach you about how you should conduct your life. I will teach you personally.
Do not be like horses and mules that do not have understanding; they need pieces of metal put in their mouth and ropes fastened to their head so they will go in the direction you want them to go.
Wicked people will have many difficult things in their lives that will make them sad, but those who trust in Yahweh will experience him faithfully loving them all the time.
{So, all} you righteous people, rejoice about {what} Yahweh {has done for you}! All you whose inner beings are pure, be glad and shout joyfully!
You people who do what is right, shout joyfully because of Yahweh, because praising him is what upright people should do.
Praise Yahweh by playing songs on the harp. Praise him as you make music for him with instruments that have many strings.
Sing a new song to him; play those instruments well, and shout joyfully as you play them!
Do this because everything that Yahweh says is true, and we can trust that everything that he does is right.
He loves everything that people do that is right and just. Yahweh faithfully loves people all over the earth.
Yahweh created everything in the sky by commanding it. He created all of the stars by speaking.
He gathered all the water of the sea into one huge mass as though scooping it into a container.
Everyone on the earth should deeply revere Yahweh.
They should revere him because he is the one who spoke, making the world exist. Everything started to exist because he is the one who commanded it.
Yahweh stops the nations from doing what they plan to do. He prevents the peoples from carrying out what they decide.
However, what Yahweh decides to do will last forever. What he plans to do will never change.
What a good life people have when Yahweh is the God of their nation; he chose those people to belong to him.
Yahweh looks down from heaven; he sees all human beings.
From the place where he lives he watches everyone who lives on the earth.
He created each person’s heart, and he knows everything that they do.
It is not because a king has a great army that he is able to win {battles}, and it is not because a soldier is very strong that he is able to defeat {his enemy}.
It is foolish to hope that a horse can save anyone; even with its great strength, it cannot rescue {its rider}.
Note this: Yahweh watches over those who deeply revere him; He watches over those who confidently expect him to faithfully love them,
to save them from dying and to preserve them alive through any famine.
We trust that Yahweh will take care of us; he will help us and protect us.
Indeed, he makes us very joyful; we trust him because he is holy.
Yahweh, we pray that you will always faithfully love us, while we confidently wait for you {to help us}.
I will always thank Yahweh; I will constantly praise him out loud.
I will boast about {what} Yahweh {has done for me}. All of the humble people who hear me will rejoice.
Join with me in telling others that Yahweh is great, and let us together proclaim how glorious he is!
I prayed to Yahweh, and he answered me; he rescued me from everything that I was afraid of.
Those who ask him {to help them} will be joyful; may Yahweh always provide for them.
I was suffering, but I called out to Yahweh, and he heard me. He saved me from all of the things that were troubling me.
An angel representing Yahweh guards people who deeply revere Yahweh, and the angel rescues them {from bad things}.
Experience for yourselves how good Yahweh is! Everyone who trusts in Yahweh will be truly happy!
All you people who belong to Yahweh, deeply revere him, because those who deeply revere him will always have everything that they need.
{Even} young lions {sometimes} go hungry and have nothing to eat, but people who trust in Yahweh for help will always have the good {things that they need}.
You who are my students, come and listen to me, and I will teach you how to deeply revere Yahweh.
If any of you want to truly live and to enjoy a good, long life,
then be careful to not say things that are harmful, and to not tell lies.
Stop doing what is evil and instead do what is good; always strive to live peacefully with others.
Yahweh pays attention to people who do what is right, and he listens when they call {to him to help them}.
But Yahweh opposes people who do what is evil. He does not allow their descendants to remain on the earth.
People who do what is right cry out to Yahweh, and he hears them; he rescues them from all the things that trouble them.
Yahweh is always ready to help people who are very sad, and he saves people who are deeply discouraged.
People who do what is right experience many bad things, but Yahweh rescues them from all of those bad things.
Yahweh protects their whole body; he does not allow {their enemies} to break even one of their bones.
Wicked people will cause themselves to die because of the evil things that they do, and Yahweh will punish those who hate righteous people.
Yahweh saves those who serve him, and he will forgive all who trust in him.
A psalm of David. Yahweh, be the enemy of my enemies! Defend me against those who attack me!
Protect me like a soldier who has both of his shields, and come to help me!
Take your spear and javelin and confront those who are pursuing me! Tell me, “I am the one who saves you.”
Please defeat and dishonor those who want to kill me, and make those who plan to harm me become confused and turn back.
May an angel from Yahweh chase them away so that they disappear like chaff in the wind.
May their lives be like running on a path that is dark and slippery, while an angel from Yahweh pursues them!
Please do these things to them, because I have not done anything wrong to them, yet they try to kill me. It is as though they hide nets and dig pits for me to walk into!
So let disaster suddenly surprise each of them! Let it be as though the nets that they hid catch them instead, and as though they fall into their own {pits} and die!
Then I will rejoice because of {what} Yahweh {has done for me}, and I will be glad because he has saved me.
With my whole being I will say, “Yahweh, no one is like you! No one else rescues weak people from those who are stronger, no one else rescues poor and needy people from those who rob them.”
Hostile people tell lies {about me} in court and accuse me of things that I know nothing about.
I was good to them. But instead of being good to me, they are evil to me. That makes me feel completely alone.
Yet for my part, when they were sick, I put on rough cloth to mourn for them; I went without food as I prayed for them, bowing my head over my chest.
I walked around grieving for them as I would grieve for a friend or for a brother, and I bowed down mourning for them as though for my own mother.
But when I suffered, they all gathered together and celebrated. People whom I did not even know gathered to attack me. They kept slandering me and would not stop.
Profane people mocked me for being lame and ground their teeth at me {to show how angry they were}.
Lord, please do more than just watch what they do! Rescue me from these people who want to destroy me! Save me from these people who are as fierce as young lions!
Then I will thank you when the great crowd of your people gather together, and I will praise you in front of all of them.
Do not let my enemies who lie about me celebrate {because they defeated me}, and do not let those who hate me for no reason wink at each other {to show how pleased they are about it}.
{Do not let them succeed,} because they do not speak peacefully {to anyone}; instead, they make up lies about quiet, peaceable people in the land.
They shout loudly to accuse me, saying, “Yes! Yes! We saw {what you did}!”
Yahweh, you have seen all of this, so please do something about it! Lord, please help me!
Become active and do the right thing for me; my God and my Lord, defend me!
Yahweh my God, because you are righteous, declare that I am innocent, and do not let my enemies celebrate {that they have defeated} me.
Do not let them think to themselves, “Yes! We got what we wanted!” Do not let them say {to each other}, “We have completely destroyed him!”
Instead, make all those who celebrate when bad things happen to me feel totally ashamed and disgraced. Yes, completely humiliate those who boast that they are greater than me.
But let those who want God to show that I am innocent shout for joy and celebrate! Let them always say, “Yahweh is great! He loves to make things go well for the one who serves him.”
Then I will tell everyone how righteous you are, and I will praise you all day long.
Wicked people act as though they are obeying a voice from deep within themselves that is urging them to sin. They have no respect for God at all.
Indeed, they are so proud that they refuse to recognize how wrongly they act so that they might hate {doing those things}.
Everything that they say is wicked and deceptive; they have stopped acting wisely and {stopped} doing what is right.
They plan sinful activities while lying on their beds; they commit themselves to a bad way of living; they do not refuse to do evil things.
Yahweh, the amount that you faithfully love us is so much that it is as though it fills the heavens. If we could measure how trustworthy you are, the amount would extend into the clouds.

Your way of doing what is right is {as permanent} as the highest mountains; your way of acting justly is {as vast and mysterious} as the deepest oceans. Yahweh, you take care of {all living creatures,} both people and animals.
God, how precious it is that you faithfully love us! You protect people just as a bird shelters its young under its wings.
You provide for them plenty of food from the abundant supply that you have; you satisfy them with good things that they enjoy, as if from a never-ending stream.
Indeed, you are the one who causes everything to live; you are the one who makes it possible for us to understand what is true.
Please continue to faithfully love those who know you, and continue to do right for those who sincerely want to do what is right.
Do not let arrogant people overcome me, and do not let wicked people force me to flee.
See how the people who do evil have fallen! God has thrown them down, and they can never get up again.
This is a psalm of David. Do not let what wicked people do upset you; do not wish that you had what people who do evil things have.
{Do not worry about them} because they will soon disappear, just as grass dries up {in the sun} and green plants quickly wither and die.
Trust in Yahweh and do what is right; live in the land {that he has given you}, and be faithful {to him}.
Also, enjoy Yahweh more than anything else; then he will give you what you desire most.
Entrust everything that you plan to do to Yahweh; trust in him, and then, for his part, he will do {whatever you need him to do}.
He will show everyone as clearly as the light of the noonday sun that you do what is right and that you are innocent of doing anything wrong.
Be calm before Yahweh and wait patiently for him {to act}. Do not become upset when you see {evil} people succeed as they do the {wicked} things that they have planned.
Stop being angry {about what wicked people do}; do not want to punish them yourself; that only leads to doing evil.
Do not do that because Yahweh will destroy people who do evil, but as for the people who trust Yahweh to act, they will possess the land.
Soon wicked people will disappear. You will look for them where they used to be, but they will be gone.
Humble people, however, will possess the land and will enjoy living {there} very peacefully and well.
Wicked people plan to harm people who do what is right. They grind their teeth at people who do what is right {to show how much they hate them}.
But the Lord scoffs at wicked people, because he knows that the time when he will judge them is coming.
Wicked people draw their swords and string their bows to kill people who are poor and helpless and to slaughter people who live honestly.
But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and the Lord will break their bows.
It is better to be a person who does what is right and to have only a few possessions than to have the abundant wealth of many wicked people.
{This is so} because Yahweh will make wicked people unable to do what they want to do, but he will take care of people who do what is right.
Each day Yahweh watches over people who do not do wrong things, and what he gives them will last forever.
During times when bad things happen they will not despair; even when there is a famine, they will still have enough {to eat}.
But wicked people will die. Those who hate Yahweh will be like wildflowers that look beautiful in the meadows; but then they will disappear {as quickly} as a puff of smoke.
Wicked people borrow {money} and never repay {it}, but people who do what is right are generous and give {freely to others}.
Moreover, those whom Yahweh blesses will possess the land, but he will destroy those whom he has cursed.
Yahweh directs a person to live securely, and he is pleased with how that person lives.
Even if something bad happens to that person, he will not completely fail, because Yahweh takes care of him.

I have been young, and now I am old, but {in all those years} I have never seen Yahweh stop caring for any person who does what is right, nor have I seen such a person’s children {needing to} beg for food.
People who do what is right are generous and lend freely {to others} every day, and their children bless others.
Avoid doing evil and do what is right. If you do that, you {and your descendants} will live in the land forever.

Indeed, Yahweh loves it when people do what is just, and he will never stop caring for those who are faithful to him. He will protect them forever, but he will destroy the descendants of wicked people.
People who do what is right will possess the land {that Yahweh gives them} and will live there forever.
People who do what is right speak wisely, and they say what is just.
They continually think about the instructions that their God gave to them; they succeed in living {the way that God wants them to live}.
Wicked people observe people who do what is right and look for ways to kill them.
But Yahweh will keep protecting them from what the wicked people want to do to them, and he will not let a judge {wrongly} condemn the people who do what is right.
Patiently rely on Yahweh {to help you} and obey what he commands. {If you do that,} he will honor you by giving you the land. When God destroys the wicked people, you will see it happen.
I once saw a wicked and tyrannical person who was becoming powerful, like a large tree that was spreading out its branches over its native soil.
But then he passed away! Suddenly, he was gone! I looked for him, but he was not there.
Observe {and imitate} people who are honest and who live rightly, because people who live peacefully will have a long life.
But Yahweh will destroy all people who rebel against him; he will make the lives of wicked people short.
Yahweh saves people who do what is right; he protects them when bad things are happening.
Yahweh helps them and rescues them from {what} wicked people {want to do to them}. He saves them because they have trusted in him {to help them}.
Yahweh, please do not correct me angrily; no, please do not punish me wrathfully.
{I feel as though} you have shot arrows into me, and that you have struck me with your hand.
Because you are so angry with me, my whole body suffers. My body is restless because I have sinned.
Indeed, all my sins {are like flood waters that} rise above my head; they are like a heavy load that is too much for me to bear.
Because I have acted foolishly, I have sores that keep getting worse and stink.
My body is twisted and bent over very low. I go around sad and grieving constantly.
This is because there is a fever inside me, and my whole body is sick.
I am exhausted and feel completely broken. I moan loudly because I feel so distressed.
Lord, you know everything that I long for, and you hear every time that I sigh.
My heart beats rapidly and I am very weak. Even my eyesight is failing me.
My friends and the people I love keep away from me because of my disease; even my own family stays far away from me.
Those who want to kill me set traps for me, and those who want to harm me talk about how to destroy me and they constantly plot how they will deceive me.
But I act like someone who is deaf, and I do not listen {to them}. I act like someone who cannot speak, and I say nothing {to them}.
I have become like a man who cannot hear and who cannot argue back.
{This is} because I wait for you, Yahweh{, to help me}. You will be the one who will respond, Lord my God.
{I know this} because I prayed, “Do not let my enemies celebrate over me. Do not let them gloat over me if something bad happens to me.”
Indeed, I feel that something bad will soon happen, and I am constantly in pain.
Certainly, I confess all the wrong things that I have done; I feel terrible about my sin.
But my vigorous enemies are powerful, and there are many people who hate me for no reason.
When I do good things for people, some of them do evil things to me in return. Those people accuse me {of doing evil things}, even though I am trying to do what is right.
Yahweh, please do not leave me! My God, please stay near me!
Come quickly to help me, Lord, you who save me!
I thought to myself, “I must be very careful about how I act so that I do not sin by what I say. I must keep myself from speaking while wicked people are near me.”
So I kept completely silent; I did not say anything, not even anything good, but my suffering only became worse.
I felt very agitated inside me; the more I pondered, the more agonized I became. Then finally I spoke and said,
“Yahweh, let me know when I will die. Tell me how many days I have left to live. Help me to understand how short my life really is.
Indeed, you have made my days very few; the time that I have to live is practically nothing to you. Truly, every person appears and disappears as quickly as vapor. Selah

Truly, each person does not do anything more substantial than a shadow would do. Truly, people become agitated about things that do not matter. They pile up {wealth}, but they do not know who will get it {after they die}.
So now, Lord, I realize that it is useless for me to expect any person to make my life purposeful. You are the only one who can do anything worthwhile for me.
Please save me from all the ways that I sin against you. Do not let me be someone whom foolish people ridicule.
I kept silent and did not say anything, because {I knew that} you were the one who caused {me to suffer}.
{But now,} please stop punishing me! As for me, because you have afflicted me, I am about to die.
When you correct a person for the wrong things that he has done, you destroy what he treasures, just as moths destroy clothing. Truly, every person lives only a very short time. Selah

Yahweh, please hear me as I pray {to you} and listen {to me} when I cry out for help. Do not ignore my tears, because I am only living before you {on the earth} for a short time, a temporary resident, just like all of my ancestors.
Please leave me alone in order that I may be happy {for awhile} before I die.”
I patiently waited for Yahweh {to help me,} and he was attentive to me and listened when I called out to him.

When bad things were happening to me, it was as though I was in a dangerous pit that was full of mud and slime but he rescued me from those terrible things as though he had lifted me out of the pit and set me onto a solid rock where I could stand securely.
He gave me reason to sing a new song, praising him, our God. Many people will see {what he did for me} and will revere him and will trust in Yahweh.
What a good life the person has who trusts confidently in Yahweh and does not imitate proud people who are loyal to what is false.

Yahweh my God, you are the one who has done many wonderful things and made {great} plans for us! No one compares to you. If I tried to tell others about all of those wonderful things, there would be too many for me to mention.

It is not the sacrifices and offerings that you have wanted {from me}; instead, you gave me the ability to hear and obey you. Burnt offerings and sin offerings are not what you require {to forgive my sins}.
So I said, “Yahweh, here I am, {ready to do the things that} the scroll of your instruction says about me.”
My God, I gladly do what you desire; I deeply treasure your instruction.
Whenever your people gather together in the large congregation, I tell them about the righteous things {that you do}. Indeed, Yahweh, certainly you know that I do not stop talking {about this}.

I have not kept to myself {the good news} that you are righteous; I have told the large gathering of your people that you are faithful and that you save us. I have not hidden from them that you faithfully love us and are always trustworthy.
Yahweh, you will not stop being merciful to me. Because you faithfully love me and are always trustworthy, {I know that} you will continually protect me.

I assure myself of this because so many bad things are happening to me that it seems that I cannot even count them. the wrong things that I have done are now affecting me badly, and I cannot see {a way to fix them}. It seems that they are more numerous than the hairs on my head, and I am very discouraged.
Yahweh, please rescue me! Yahweh, please come quickly to help me!
May God completely disgrace all of the people who want to kill me. May God frustrate the people who want me to suffer and may he humiliate them.
May those who mock me, saying, “Ha, Ha!” feel horrified because God has so humiliated them.
May all those who come to worship you be very joyful because of you. May those who love that you save them say continually, “Yahweh is great!”
As for me, I am very poor, but the Lord cares about me. You are the one who rescues me; my God, please do not wait any longer!
What a good life those people have who help powerless people! When bad things happen to them, Yahweh will rescue them.
Yahweh will protect them and people will see that things turn our well for them as they live in the land. {Yahweh,} please do not let their enemies do what they want with them.
Yahweh will strengthen them when they are sick; {Yahweh,} you completely restore them whenever they become ill.
As for me, I said, “Yahweh, please be merciful to me and heal me. {I am sick} because I have sinned against you.”
My enemies say hateful things about me; they say, “We want him to die so that everyone will forget him!”
Whenever one of them comes to visit {me}, he says things that mean nothing. He secretly collects harmful information, then he goes outside and tells {it to everyone}.
Everyone who hates me whispers about me to one another; they plot how to harm me.
{They say about me,} “Something terrible has happened to him, and he will never get up from where he is lying.”
Even my closest friend, the one I trusted, who shared meals with me, has greatly betrayed me.
However, Yahweh, please be merciful to me and make me well, so that I can do to them what they did to me.
When you do this, I will know that you are pleased with me, when my enemies {will not be able to defeat me and so} cannot rejoice about it.
As for me, you have helped me because I live honestly, and you will allow me to be with you forever.
We should all praise Yahweh, the God whom the people of Israel worship! People should praise him at all times, now and forever! Yes, let it be so!

When a wild deer is very thirsty, it takes short, quick breaths because it wants so badly to find a brook from which it can drink water. That is how much I want you, God. It is as if I am taking short, quick breaths.
You are the only true God, and I desire very greatly to be in your temple again and worship in your presence. I desire that so much that it is as if I am very thirsty.
I have been crying continually. I have been crying so much that I have not been able to eat. This is because my enemies keep telling me, “Your God will certainly not help you!”

It is appropriate for me to weep to express my great sorrow. But {to encourage myself,} I should also remember how I used to go with large groups of people to celebrate festivals at God’s temple. {Because I was one of the worship musicians,} I would lead the people as they walked to the temple. {On the way there,} we all shouted joyfully and praised God.
So I certainly should not be so sad and upset! I can confidently expect God to rescue me! When he does, I will have the opportunity to praise him as my savior and
my God. But I do feel very sad. So {even though I am a long distance from your temple, God} I will remember you from here at Mount Mizar in the land near Mount Hermon where the Jordan River begins.

The waterfalls you created make such a loud sound that it is as if one deep stream were shouting to another deep stream within the river. I feel such anguish that it is as if one wave after another were crashing over me.
Yahweh continually loves me faithfully as he promised. In response, as he inspires me, I continually sing prayers to him. He is the God who keeps me alive.
God is like a huge rock on top of which I am safe. So I will pray to him, “Please pay attention to me! I am living sorrowfully because my enemies are afflicting me!”
Those enemies are continually insulting me. They keep telling me, “Your God will certainly not help you!” When they insult me like that, it is as painful as if they were breaking my bones.
But I certainly should not be so sad and upset! I can confidently expect God to rescue me! When he does, I will have the opportunity to praise him as my savior and my God.
Please protect me, God, from the people who are being so cruel to me. Please consider that I do not deserve that. Rescue me from people who would deceive me and treat me unfairly.
{I ask you to do this} because you are the God who protects me, and yet I feel as if you have abandoned me! I am living sorrowfully because my enemies are afflicting me.
Treat me favorably, as if you were smiling at me. Help me, as you have promised to do for those who are loyal to you. Guide me so that I can return to your temple on Mount Zion.
{When I do come to Zion,} I will go to your altar {to worship you}. O God, you make me very joyful! {At your altar,} I will sing praise to you, the God whom I worship, as I play the harp.
So I certainly should not be so sad and upset! I can confidently expect God to rescue me! When he does, I will have the opportunity to praise him as my savior and my God.
God, we listened carefully when our ancestors told us about the great things you did long ago when the Israelites first came into the land of Canaan.

{They told us about} how powerfully you forced the other nations to leave and established our ancestors securely in their land. It was as if they had been plants that you put firmly in the ground. You destroyed the people groups that had lived there and enabled our ancestors to settle there.
Our ancestors did not conquer this land with their own weapons or by their own power. Instead, you helped them and defeated their enemies by your own great power. You did that because you loved them.
You are our real king, O God. Please enable the people of Israel to defeat their enemies.
You enable us to defeat our enemies. Because you help us, we destroy armies that fight against us.
We do not expect to win victories because of the weapons we have.
Instead, you rescue us from our enemies. You disgrace our opponents {by defeating them}.
We regularly celebrate what God has done for us. We will always praise him. Selah
But now it appears that you no longer want to help us. This has embarrassed us. When our armies march out to fight a battle, you no longer enable them to win victories.
You make us retreat from our enemies. We must leave behind weapons and possessions, and they take as many of those as they want.
You have allowed our enemies to slaughter us as if we were sheep. Foreign armies have captured many of our people and taken them back to their countries as slaves.
You did not even receive any money for allowing others to take your people as their slaves. You did not become any richer as a result of that.
Because you no longer help us, the people groups around us insult us. They express contempt for us and laugh at us.
People in other nations are using us Israelites as an example of an unfortunate people group. They are shaking their heads at us to ridicule us.
I am constantly aware of my disgrace. I feel complete shame
because people are speaking so harshly to me. Those people are my enemies, and they want to harm me.
These things have happened to us even though we have not stopped worshiping you and we have not disobeyed the solemn agreement that you made with our ancestors.
We still love you as our God, and we have continued to do what you have commanded us to do.
But {you have allowed} our enemies to ruin our land and leave it desolate. You have left us feeling as though we are going to die.
If we had stopped worshiping you as our God and had started worshiping a foreign god,
you would surely have known that. That is because you know even what people secretly think.
Because you are not helping us, our enemies are continuing to kill our people. They believe they can kill us as easily as if we were sheep, which people slaughter easily.
Protect us! Do not fail to act, Lord, as if you were asleep! Defend us! Do not keep treating us as if we were not your people!
Please be favorable to us and help us! Consider how badly our enemies are harming us and how greatly we are suffering!
We ask you to do this because we are helpless, as if we had fallen down and were lying on the ground and could not get up.
You have promised to love us faithfully because we belong to you. So please do something to rescue us from our enemies!

There is something wonderful that I feel so strongly about that I must sing about it. I will sing a song that I have composed in honor of the king. As I sing, I will express my ideas in an orderly and complete way, just like a scribe who records quickly and accurately what he hears people say.
O King, you are the most handsome man in the world! You speak very graciously! So we know that God has always blessed you.
Prepare yourself to keep fighting powerfully {for justice}! You are glorious and majestic when you do that.

Go and win victories to establish yourself as a king who is honest, who does not proudly oppress his people, and who does what is right. As you do that, may you find that your skill as a warrior terrifies anyone who would resist you.
Your sharp arrows pierce into the hearts of your enemies. You defeat the people groups that fight against you.
Your Majesty, you will be the king for a very long time. You decide people’s cases fairly as you rule your kingdom.
You love it when people do what is right, and you hate it when people do what is wrong. That is why God, whom you worship, has made you so happy. You are happier than all the people around you.

Your royal robes smell beautifully of {the spices} myrrh, aloes, and cassia. From within your palace, which has ivory decorations, you hear people playing stringed instruments. That music makes you happy.
The honored women of your court include foreign princesses. {Your bride,} the queen, is standing at your right side. Threads of gold fine gold from Ophir decorate her robe.
And as for you, dear bride, please listen carefully to my advice. From now on, regard this as your country and these people as your family.
If you do that, the king will love and appreciate you even more. Bow down in front of him to honor him as your husband and king.
Representatives of {foreign kingdoms such as the wealthy kingdom} of Tyre will bring gifts to you. The wealthy people of this kingdom will ask you to treat them favorably.
This royal princess looked so beautiful in her private room where she had dressed for the wedding! She had put on a robe that gold threads richly decorated.
As she came in procession to where you are, O king, people could see that her robe also had beautiful designs of colored thread. Other young women, her bridesmaids, followed her in that procession.
As they came in procession into your palace, this made everyone very happy.
You will be famous not because of your ancestors but because of your descendants. They will have influence and authority all over the world.
{By this song,} I want to make the people of future generations remember what a great king you are. Then people will always say good things about you.
God keeps us safe, as if he were a secure place where we could go if we were in danger. God strengthens us. He is always present to help us when we have troubles.
So we would not be afraid even if there were an earthquake that caused huge chunks of mountains to fall deep into the sea.
We would not be afraid even if there were a great storm in the ocean whose surging waves battered the coastline. Selah
A stream flows down from the mountains into Jerusalem. Its cool waters refresh the people who live there. Jerusalem is the location of God’s holy temple. He is greater than all other spirit beings.
God is present in Jerusalem in a special way, so no one destroys it. God rescues the people of that city, and it is as if a dark night ends and a bright new day begins.
Sometimes foreign armies invade kingdoms and conquer them. {But that does not happen to us, because} God powerfully defends us and defeats our enemies.
Yahweh, the commander of the heavenly armies, helps us. The God whom we Israelites worship keeps us safe. Selah
Let me tell you what Yahweh does. He destroys our enemies.
He stops wars all over the world. It is as if he breaks bows and arrows, destroys spears, and burns up war wagons.
God says, “Calm down and remember that I am God. The people of nations throughout the earth will honor me.”
Yahweh, the commander of the heavenly armies, helps us. The God whom we Israelites worship keeps us safe. Selah
People all over the world, clap your hands! Shout joyfully to praise God!
Everyone should revere Yahweh, who is much greater than any other spirit being. He rules powerfully over the whole world!
He enables us to conquer people groups that oppose us.
He loved our ancestor Jacob, and so he chose this land to be our possession. We are proud of the land he gave us. Selah
People have acclaimed Yahweh their God as their king by shouting and blowing ram’s horns.
Sing songs to praise God our King! Yes, sing songs to praise him!
Do that because God rules the whole world. Sing a special song about that.
God rules over all people groups. He rules them completely fairly, not the way many human kings do.

The rulers of the people groups will assemble to join those who worship the same God whom Abraham worshiped. They will do that because the leaders of the world must obey God. He is the supreme ruler of the world.

Yahweh is great, and he deserves to have people praise him greatly in {Jerusalem}, the city that belongs to him. That city is high up on the mountain that he chose as the place where people would worship him.

The height of Mount Zion is magnificent. People from all over the world are happy when they see it. The city {of Jerusalem,} where Yahweh rules as the great king, is on the northern ridge of that mountain.
God is present {as a defender} in the city’s fortifications. He has shown that he protects the people of the city.
Listen to why Yahweh deserves our praise. Kings joined together and led their armies to attack our city.
However, when they saw it, its secure position and defenses amazed them. They became so frightened that they ran away.
Their bodies shook because they were so afraid. They screamed as if they were women who were giving birth.
Just as you, Yahweh, can sent a strong east wind that wrecks even the sturdiest ships at sea{, so you destroyed the armies that were attacking us}.

Jerusalem belongs to Yahweh, the commander of the heavenly armies, who is our God. We had heard {from our ancestors} that God would always keep the city secure. Now we who live in the city have seen for ourselves that this is true. Selah
We went into your temple, God, and recognized that you faithfully kept your covenant when you protected us. We acknowledged that you had been just as faithful to us as you were to our ancestors.
People throughout the world praise you as you deserve. You use your power to make sure that people treat each other right.
The people who live in Jerusalem and in other parts of the kingdom of Judah should celebrate the way you judge people fairly.
You Judeans should walk around the walls of the city of Jerusalem. See how many defensive towers it has!
You should observe the strength of the walls and the fortifications so that you can tell your descendants about them.
The people of Judah and Jerusalem should praise Yahweh because he is our God and he will always be our God. He will lead us for as long as we live.
Listen to me, members of people groups from throughout the world,
whether or not you are famous and whether or not you are rich!
I have thought carefully about what I am going to say, so it will be wise, and it will help you understand things better.
There is a popular saying about something that people find difficult to understand. I have considered it, and I will explain it as I {sing and} play my harp.
I do not have to be afraid during difficult times when wicked people around me try to harm me.
These wicked people believe that they will be able to use their money to overcome any difficulty. They boast about how rich they are.
No one can use his money to keep a person from dying. No, no one can pay God money so that another person will not die.
No matter how much money a person has, it is never enough to keep someone else from dying
so that the person will live forever and never leave this world.
Whether people are wise or foolish and brutish, they all die. Then other people inherit their money.
They imagine that the houses they live in will always exist. They call their properties by their own names {as if they would always have them}.
Even if someone is great, he does not stay that way. He still dies, just as animals do.
Those who think and act as if they will never die are living in a foolish manner. Even so, some other people admire them and approve of what they say. Selah

God has determined that they will die, as easily as sheep die, and go to the place where dead people are. They will remain there, as if death were a shepherd keeping them in a pen. One day God will make righteous people rule over wicked people. Wicked people will no longer live in comfortable homes. Instead, their bodies will decay in their graves.
But God will take me to himself. In that way, he will rescue me from the place where dead people are. Selah
Do not let it trouble you when a person becomes rich and has many valuable possessions.
After all, when that person dies, he will take nothing with him {to the place where dead people are}. He will not be able to bring his money there with him.
While a rich person is alive, he says to himself that he is successful. (People tend to praise anyone who is successful.)
Nevertheless, he will die and go to where his dead ancestors are. All of them will remain in that dark place forever.
If someone is great but does not understand these things, he will die, just as animals do.
A Levite from the clan of Asaph wrote this song. Yahweh is the only true God. He has decreed that people from all over the world should come to him.
Mount Zion is as wonderful as a place can be {because God’s temple is there}. God’s presence there is like a light that shines brightly.

Our God is approaching us {to judge us}. He will now tell us {what we have done right and what we have done wrong}. He is coming very powerfully, as he did at Mount Sinai, when there was a great thunderstorm and a burning fire on the mountain as he approached it.
He calls upon the sky and the land {to serve as witnesses of his covenant with the Israelites}. This demonstrates that he will judge them fairly {according to that covenant}.
He says, “Summon those who worship me faithfully, those who made a covenant with me that involved offering sacrifices to me.”
The sky displays the character of God so clearly, it is as though it is saying, “God is righteous, and he is the supreme judge.” Selah
God says, “You Israelite people who belong to me, listen as I speak to you. I am the God whom you worship. I am going to tell you what you have done right and what you have done wrong.
You continually burn animals completely on the temple altar as sacrifices to me, so I have no complaint that you have failed to offer sacrifices to me.
However, I do not really need the bulls from your herds or the goats from your pens {that you sacrifice to me}.
I do not need them, because all of the animals that live in the forests belong to me. All of the cattle everywhere on earth also belong to me.
I own all the birds that live in the mountains. All the little creatures that move around in the fields also belong to me.
Because everything in the world belongs to me, if I were hungry, I would not tell you {so that you would bring me some food to eat}.
When you sacrifice bulls to me, I do not eat their flesh, and when you offer goats to me, I do not drink their blood.
I want you to offer sacrifices to me, your God, because you have promised to do that to thank me for helping you. I am the God who is greater than all other spirit beings.
So pray to me when you are in trouble. If you do that, I will rescue you, and then you will honor me {publicly by offering a sacrifice}.”
But God says to wicked people, “You should not be reciting my commandments or talking about the covenant that I made with you!
You should not do that, because you hate it when I correct you, and when I tell you to do something, you refuse to obey me.
When you see someone stealing, you decide that it is acceptable for him to steal. When you learn that people are having sexual relations with people other than their spouses, you do the same thing.
You do not restrain yourselves from saying wicked things, and you make up things to say to deceive people.
You consistently say bad things about members of your own family, even about your closest relatives.

You do all those things, and I have not said anything to you about them, so you think that I do not care about them any more than you do. But now I am going to show you {all the wicked things you have done}, and I am going to judge and punish you for doing them.
Many of you have been ignoring me. Pay attention to what I am saying now! If you do not, I will destroy you. No one will be able to rescue you.
When people publicly offer sacrifices to thank me for helping them, that honors me greatly. If people live as I want people to live, I will rescue them when they are in trouble.”
Oh God, since you promised to faithfully love me, please act mercifully toward me. You gently love people in many ways, so please forgive me for disobeying you so badly.
Remove my sin completely, as if it were dirt that you were washing off me to make me clean.
I ask this because I know that I have disobeyed you in many ways. I am continually aware of that.

What grieves me most is how I have sinned against you. I have done things that you consider to be very wrong. So when you declare that I am guilty, you are right. When you judge me, you are completely fair.
Indeed, I have been a sinner from birth. In fact, I have been a sinner since my mother conceived me.
I know that you want me to have honest intentions. You help me understand very well how to act wisely.

Make me acceptable to you again, as if you were using hyssop to sprinkle water on me to purify me. Remove my sin as if it were dirt that you were washing off me. Then I will be completely pure, like snow that has just fallen.
Please tell me {that you have forgiven me}. That would make me very happy. My guilt feels like a heavy weight on me, but may I rejoice {in your forgiveness}.
Please forgive all the wrong things I have done so that it will be as if I never did them.
O God, please make me want to do only things that please you. Help me to be loyal to you consistently.
Please allow me to come into your presence. Please do not make your Holy Spirit leave me.
Please save me {from the guilt and punishment of my sin}. That will make me very happy again. Please make me eager to obey you so that I do not sin again.
Please make me so obedient that I can even teach people who are doing wrong things how you want them to live instead. That way people who have been disobeying you will start obeying you again.

God, I admit that I deserve to die because I murdered someone, but please rescue me from that punishment. You can save me {from the guilt and punishment of my sin} because you are God. When you do that, I will sing joyfully about how good you are.
Lord, {please do these things so that} I will have a reason to speak publicly and say things to praise you.

If you had wanted me to offer a sacrifice {because of the sin I committed}, I would certainly have done that. But you do not accept burnt offerings {from people who bring them to try to make things right with you after committing murder}.
What you really want is for people to pray to you in genuine humility {and ask for forgiveness}. When a person is very sorrowful for his sin, you, God, do not reject him.
Please regard us Israelites favorably and help us. Protect us from our enemies.

Then people will offer sacrifices to you for the right reasons. They will bring animals that they will burn completely as offerings to you. They will completely burn up young bulls on your altar. You will gladly accept these sacrifices.
{Doeg,} you are boasting as if you were a great warrior because you killed so many people{, but you are wrong to boast, because they were helpless}. God always protects me because he is kind to me.

You say things that you know will cause great harm to other people. It is as if your tongue is a sharp knife slashing people. People did something innocently, but you reported it in such a way that they seemed to be guilty.
You like to do what is wrong more than you like to do what is right. You like to tell lies more than you like to tell the truth. Selah
You like to say anything that will cause harm to people. What you say causes innocent people to suffer.

But God will destroy you permanently, just as you have destroyed others. You may feel safe in your home, but God will take you from there and remove you from this world in which people are alive. Selah
When good people see that, they will respect God {for being just}. They will laugh at you.

{They will say,} “Look what happened to this man who did not trust God to protect him. He thought that because he had a lot of money, he could avoid trouble. He believed that harming other people would make him powerful.”
But I am safe, just like the olive trees that the priests plant and care for in the courtyard of the place where we worship God. I know that God will always be kind to me.

I am confident that you, God, are going to do what I have described, and I will always praise you for that. You have demonstrated to the people who are faithful to you that you are good. So I will wait patiently for you to act according to your good character.
People who do not want to obey God tell themselves that God does not exist. People like that are bad. They do terrible things. Every one of them acts wickedly.
God looks down from heaven at the people on the earth. He wants to find out whether any of them are wise and want to know him.
But they have all chosen to disobey God. They have all become bad people. Every single one of them acts wickedly.

They take away people’s possessions until they have nothing left. They do that as easily as they would eat a loaf of bread. The people who do such bad things ought to realize {that God is going to punish them}. But they do not worship God.

An army came and attacked the Israelites. Its soldiers did not have to be afraid that the Israelites would defeat them. But God made them lose in battle so badly that the survivors were not even able to bury the dead soldiers. This made them very afraid.
