The land of Egypt will become completely deserted and ruined. Then the people of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh. I will do this because you, their king, boasted that the Nile River belongs to you because you made it.

Therefore, listen! I am against you and against the channels of your river. I will ruin the land of Egypt completely and leave it deserted, from Migdol in the north to Syene in the south, as far as the border of the land of Cush.
No person will walk through that land, and no animal will walk through it. No one will live there for forty years.

For forty years I will keep the land of Egypt and all its cities as desolate as the other lands and cities that enemies have devastated. I will scatter the people of Egypt among the other nations and force them to live in foreign lands.’
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘After 40 years have passed, I will gather the people of Egypt back from the nations where I scattered them.
I will cause them to prosper again. I will bring them back to the region of Pathros {in southern Egypt}, the land that their ancestors came from. There they will be a weak and unimportant kingdom.
Egypt will be the least important kingdom of all, and it will never again make itself greater than the other nations. I will make its people so few that they will never again rule over other nations.

The people of Israel will never again trust the Egyptians to help them. Instead, whenever the Israelites remember how they sought help from Egypt, they will remember that they sinned by doing that. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”
In the twenty-seventh year after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia, on the first day of the first month, Yahweh gave me a message. He said,

“Human, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon made his army work extremely hard when they attacked the city of Tyre. The soldiers carried such heavy loads that they rubbed all the hair off their heads and rubbed the skin off their shoulders. Yet neither Nebuchadnezzar nor his army received anything from Tyre to pay them for all the hard work that they did there.

Therefore, this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘I am about to give the land of Egypt to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. He will carry away all the wealth of Egypt and take everything valuable in that land as plunder. That wealth will be the pay for his army.
I have given him the land of Egypt as the pay for the hard work that his army did when they attacked Tyre, because they did that work for me.’ That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
On that day I will cause the people of Israel to become strong again, and I will enable you, Ezekiel, to speak freely among them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, prophesy and say that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘Wail and cry out loudly, because a terrible day is coming!
That day is near; the day when I, Yahweh, will punish people is very close. It will be a time of gloom and disaster, a time when I judge the nations.

An enemy army will come to attack Egypt with swords, and the people of Cush will suffer terribly. When those soldiers kill many people in Egypt, they will carry away the crowds of Egyptians as captives, and they will tear down everything that holds the nation together.
The soldiers of Cush, Put, and Lud, all the foreign troops who fight for Egypt, the people of Cub, and the Judeans who live in Egypt will all die in battle along with the Egyptians.’

I, Yahweh, say this, ‘The nations that help Egypt will fall, and the Egyptians will no longer be able to boast about how strong they are. Enemy soldiers will kill them in battle everywhere in Egypt, from Migdol in the north to Syene in the south.’ That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
‘I will make the land of Egypt as desolate as the other lands that I have devastated, and its cities will lie in ruins like the other cities that enemies have destroyed.
Then the people of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because I will set fire to Egypt and defeat every nation that helps her.

On that day I will send messengers out from me in ships to terrify the people of Cush, who until then think that they are safe. They will tremble with fear when I punish Egypt. Be sure of this: that day is coming!’
I, the Lord Yahweh, say this, ‘I will use King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon to put an end to the crowds of people in Egypt.

I am bringing Nebuchadnezzar and his army, soldiers who are more ruthless than any other people, to ruin the land. They will attack Egypt with their swords, and they will kill so many people that dead bodies will lie all over the land.
I will dry up the channels of the Nile River, and I will hand the land over to evil men. I will use foreigners to ruin the land and everything in it.’ I, Yahweh, have spoken.

I, the Lord Yahweh, say this, ‘I will completely destroy the worthless idols that people worship in the city of Memphis. No one will ever rule as a prince in the land of Egypt again, and I will terrify everyone who lives in Egypt.
I will make the region of Pathros in southern Egypt desolate. I will set fire to the city of Zoan, and I will punish the people of the city of Thebes.
Because I am extremely angry, I will punish the city named Sin, the fortress that protects Egypt, and I will kill the crowds of people in the city of Thebes.

I will set fire to Egypt. The people who live in the city named Sin will suffer agonizing pain, enemies will break through the walls of the city of Thebes, and enemies will attack the city of Memphis every day.
Enemy soldiers will kill the young men of the cities of Aven and Pi Beseth, and they will take the people of those cities away as captives.

In the city of Tahpanhes it will be a day of disaster, because there I will put an end to Egypt’s power to dominate other nations, and the Egyptians will no longer be able to boast about how strong they are. The people there will experience constant trouble, and enemies will take away the people of Tahpanhes and the surrounding communities as captives.
That is how I will punish Egypt, and then people will know that I am Yahweh.’”
In the eleventh year after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia, on the seventh day of the first month, Yahweh gave me a message. He said,

“Human, I have destroyed the military power of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. No one has done anything to restore that power, just as no one puts medicine on a broken arm or wraps a bandage around it so that it can heal and grow strong enough to grip a sword again. Egypt will never recover its strength for war.

Therefore, this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘I am now the enemy of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. I will {take away all the power that he still has, as though I} broke both of his arms, the arm that is still strong and the arm that I have already broken, and I will make the sword drop out of his hand {so that he can fight no longer}.
I will scatter the people of Egypt so that they live among many other nations, far away in foreign lands.

I will make the king of Babylon strong, and I will use him to carry out my judgment. I will shatter the power of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh will groan loudly in front of the king of Babylon, the way a man groans when someone has wounded him so badly that he is about to die.

I will make the king of Babylon strong, but Pharaoh will become completely helpless. Then people will know that I am Yahweh, because I will make the king of Babylon the one who carries out my judgment, and he will attack the land of Egypt.
I will scatter the people of Egypt so that they live among many other nations, far away in foreign lands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
In the eleventh year after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia, on the first day of the third month, Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, say to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to the crowds of people he rules, ‘You think that no one has ever been as great as you are.

Consider Assyria. That nation was once like a cedar tree in Lebanon, a tree with beautiful branches that gave shade to everything under it. It grew very tall, and its top rose above the thick foliage around it.

Plenty of water made that tree grow big, and deep underground springs made it grow tall. Those springs sent their streams flowing all around the ground where the tree grew, and they sent channels of water out to every other tree in the field.
So that tree grew taller than all the other trees in the field. It put out many limbs, and its branches grew long and spread out, because it had so much water.

Birds of every kind built their nests in its limbs, and wild animals of every kind gave birth to their young under its branches. The people of many great nations used to live in its shade{, safe under its protection}.
That tree was magnificent, because it was so big and its branches were so long. Its roots reached down to plenty of water.

Not even the cedar trees in God’s garden could match it. No cypress tree had limbs like its limbs, and no plane tree had branches like its branches. No tree in God’s garden was as beautiful as that one.
I made it beautiful, giving it many branches, and {the rulers of all the other nations, who were like} the other trees in Eden, the garden of God, envied it.
So this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, “That tree grew very tall and pushed its top up above the thick foliage, and it became arrogant because it was so tall.
Therefore I handed it over to a ruler who was mightier than all the other nations, and he certainly did to it what it deserved. I drove that nation out because it had acted so wickedly.

Foreigners, soldiers more ruthless than any other people, chopped that tree down and left it lying there. Its branches fell on the mountains and in all the valleys, and those soldiers broke its boughs to pieces in every ravine in the land. All the peoples who had lived in its shade went away and abandoned it.
Birds of every kind came and settled on the trunk of that fallen tree, and wild animals of every kind stayed among its broken branches.

I did all this so that no other nation that flourishes like a well-watered tree would ever grow so tall again, or push its top up above the thick foliage, and so that not even the mightiest of those trees, none of the ones that drink plenty of water, would ever stand so high again. I have appointed them all to die and to go down to the world below the earth, along with human beings who go down into the grave.”

This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, “On the day when that tree went down to the place where dead people go, I caused people to mourn for it. I covered over the deep springs that watered it and held back their rivers, so that the abundant water stopped flowing. Because that tree fell, I made the whole land of Lebanon mourn, and I caused all the other trees of the field to wither.

When the nations heard that it had fallen, I made them tremble with fear, for I brought that tree down to the place where dead people go, together with all those who go down into the grave. Down in the world below the earth, the other trees of Eden, the choicest and finest trees of Lebanon, all the ones that had plenty of water, found comfort when it came down to join them.

Those other nations also went down with it to the place where dead people go, to join those whom enemies had killed with swords. They had been its strength; they were its allies, and they had lived under its protection among the nations.

You Egyptians think that no tree in Eden was ever as glorious and as great as you are. However, I will bring you down, along with those trees of Eden, to the world below the earth. You will lie there dead, among men who do not have the mark of circumcision on their bodies, together with those whom enemies have killed with swords. This whole parable about the great tree describes Pharaoh and all the crowds of people he rules.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.’”
In the twelfth year {after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia}, on the first day of the twelfth month, Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, sing a funeral song about Pharaoh the king of Egypt. Say this to him, ‘You think that you are like a young lion that hunts among the nations, but really you are like a monster that lives in the sea. You thrash about in the streams of your river, churning up the water with your feet and making those streams muddy.
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, “I will gather the armies of many peoples, and I will spread my net over you, and those armies will haul you up in my dragnet.

Then I will fling you down on the ground and toss you out in an open field. I will let every kind of bird come and settle on you, and I will let wild animals from everywhere eat your dead body until they are full.
I will spread your flesh over the mountains, and I will fill the valleys with your rotting remains.
Your blood will soak the ground all the way to the mountains, and it will fill the ravines.
When I put an end to you, I will cover the sky and darken the stars in it. I will hide the sun behind a cloud, and the moon will not shine.
I will darken every shining light in the sky above you, and I will bring darkness and disaster on your land.” That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
“I will deeply disturb many peoples when I carry the news of how I shattered you out among the nations, even to lands that you have never known about.

I will horrify many peoples because of what happens to you. Their kings will shudder violently because they will be afraid that I will do the same to them. On the day when you fall, they will tremble constantly, each one fearing for his own life.”
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, “The army of the king of Babylon will come to attack you.

I will let mighty warriors, the most ruthless soldiers of all the nations, kill your huge crowds of people with their swords. Those warriors will ruin everything that the people of Egypt boast about, and they will destroy all the crowds of people there.
I will also destroy all the cattle that graze beside Egypt’s abundant waters. Never again will any person or any animal walk in those waters and stir up the mud.
Then I will let the waters of Egypt settle, and I will let its rivers flow smoothly and quietly.” That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

“The people of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh because I will turn the land of Egypt into an empty wasteland and strip the land of everything that fills it, and I will strike down everyone who lives there.
This is a funeral song, and the women of the nations will chant it. They will chant it as they mourn for Egypt and for all its crowds of people.” That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’”
In the twelfth year after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia, on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month, Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, cry loudly for the crowds of people in Egypt. Command Egypt and the people of other mighty nations to go down to the world below the earth, to join those who go down into the grave.
{Taunt the people of Egypt like this,} ‘You are no more delightful than anyone else! Go down and lie down there with godless men!’

The people of Egypt will fall down dead among all those whom enemies have killed with swords. I have handed Egypt over to enemies who carry swords; those enemies will drag Egypt away, along with all its crowds of people.

From the place where dead people go, the mightiest of the warriors will speak to Pharaoh and to those who helped him. They will say, ‘They have come down here, and now they lie here, godless men, whom enemies killed with swords.’
Assyria is there, along with its whole army, and the graves of its soldiers lie all around it. Enemies killed every one of them with swords.

Their graves lie in the deepest part of the grave, and the graves of Assyria’s army surround its burial place. Enemies killed every one of them with swords, those soldiers who once terrified people while they were still alive.

Elam is there, along with all its crowds of people, and their graves surround its burial place. Enemies killed every one of them with swords. They went down to the world below the earth without God, and while they were still alive they terrified people. Now they suffer disgrace along with those who go down into the grave.

People have made a place for Elam to lie down among all those whom enemies killed, together with all its crowds of people, and their graves surround it. They are all godless, and enemies killed them all with swords, because while they were still alive they terrified people. So now they suffer disgrace along with those who go down into the grave. People have laid Elam among all those whom enemies killed.

Meshech and Tubal are there, along with all their crowds of people, and their graves surround them. They are all godless, and enemies stabbed them all to death with swords, because while they were still alive they too terrified people.

They do not lie among the mighty godless warriors who fell in battle and went down to the place where dead people go carrying their weapons of war. People laid the swords of those warriors under their heads, yet their guilt remained with their bones even after they died, because while they were alive those warriors terrified people.
As for you, Pharaoh, I will shatter you, and you will lie down dead among godless men, together with those whom enemies killed with swords.

Edom is there, with its kings and all its leaders. In spite of all their strength, people have laid them among those whom enemies killed with swords. They lie there with godless men, along with those who go down into the grave.

All the princes of the north are there, and every Sidonian is there too. They went down with those whom enemies killed. They were strong and terrorized people but now they are ashamed. They lie there without God, together with those whom enemies killed with swords, and they suffer disgrace along with those who go down into the grave.

Pharaoh will see all of them, and he will find comfort in knowing that others suffered the same fate as all his crowds of people— Pharaoh and his whole army, whom enemies killed with swords.” That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

“I allowed Pharaoh to terrify people while they were still alive, so now I will lay him down among godless men, together with those whom enemies killed with swords— Pharaoh and all his crowds of people. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, speak to your fellow Israelites and say this to them, ‘Suppose I send an enemy army to attack a country, and the people of that country choose one of their men and appoint him to be their watchman.
Suppose he sees the enemy army coming to attack the country, and he blows a ram’s horn to warn the people.
Then if someone hears the sound of the horn but pays no attention to the warning, and the enemy soldiers come and kill him, he is responsible for his own death.
He heard the sound of the horn, but he paid no attention to the warning, so he is responsible for his own death. If he had paid attention to the warning, he would have saved his own life.

But suppose the watchman sees the enemy army coming and does not blow the horn to warn the people, and the enemy soldiers come and kill one of them. That person will die because of his own sin, but I will hold the watchman responsible for that person’s death.’
Now as for you, human, I have appointed you to be like a watchman for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, and warn them for me.

Suppose I tell a wicked person that he will certainly die because of his sins, and you say nothing to warn that wicked person to stop behaving wickedly. Then that wicked person will die because he has sinned, but I will hold you responsible for his death.
But suppose you do warn that wicked person to stop behaving wickedly, and he refuses to stop. Then he will die because he has sinned, but you will have saved your own life.
Now you human, tell the people of Israel that they keep saying, ‘We feel great emotional and physical pain because we are guilty because we sinned by rebelling against God. How can we go on living?’

Say this to them: ‘I, the Lord Yahweh, solemnly declare that as surely as I am alive, I am certainly not pleased when wicked people die. Instead, I am pleased when they stop behaving wickedly and so go on living. So repent! Stop your evil behavior! You people of Israel, there is no reason at all for you to die!’

Now you human, say this to your fellow Israelites: ‘If righteous people start to rebel, the righteous things they did before will not rescue them. And if wicked people stop behaving wickedly, the sins that they committed before will not ruin them. Righteous people who start to sin will not go on living just because they were righteous before.

Suppose I tell a righteous person that he will certainly go on living, but then he relies on the righteous things he has done and starts doing what is wrong. I will not remember any of the righteous things that he did. He will die because of the wrong things that he is doing.
But suppose I tell a wicked person that he will certainly die, but then he stops sinning and starts doing what is just and right.

Suppose he gives back what someone handed him to guarantee a loan, and he returns what he stole, and he obeys my rules that cause people to flourish, so that he no longer does what is wrong. Then he will certainly go on living; he will not die.
I will forgive any of the sins that he committed. He has done what is just and right, so he will certainly go on living.
Yet your fellow Israelites say that I, the Lord, do not act fairly. But it is what they do that is not fair.
If a righteous person stops doing what is right and starts doing what is wrong, he will die because of those wrong things.
But if a wicked person stops behaving wickedly and starts doing what is just and right, he will go on living because of those good things.
But you people still say that I, the Lord, do not act fairly. I will judge each one of you people of Israel according to how you have behaved.’”

In the twelfth year after the Babylonians took us people of Israel away to Babylonia, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, “Our enemies have captured the city!”
The evening before that man arrived, the power of Yahweh came over me. By the time the man reached me the next morning, Yahweh had enabled me to speak again, so I could no longer keep silent.
Then Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, the people who are living among the ruins in the land of Israel keep saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet Yahweh gave him this whole land to possess. We are many, so Yahweh has surely given this land to us to possess.’

So tell them that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘You eat meat that still has the animal’s blood in it. You trust your idols and worship them. You murder people. So you will certainly not go on possessing this land!
You rely on your swords to get what you want. You do detestable things. Each of you has sexual relations with another man’s wife. So you will certainly not go on possessing this land!’

Also tell them that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘As surely as I am alive, enemy soldiers will kill with their swords those who are living among the ruins. I will let wild animals eat those who are out in the open country. Those who are hiding in fortresses and caves will die from a deadly disease.

I will make the land completely empty and ruined. The people will no longer be proud of how strong their country is. The mountains of Israel will become so desolate that no one will travel through them.
Then, when I have made the land empty and ruined because of all the detestable things that they have done, they will know that I am Yahweh.’

As for you, human, your fellow Israelites are talking about you as they stand beside the walls and in the doorways of their houses, where people gather to talk. They keep saying to one another, ‘Come on, let us go and hear the message that Yahweh is giving!’

So my people come to you in large crowds, and they sit down in front of you and listen to what you say. But they do not do what you tell them. All they talk about is how they are planning to become richer.

Indeed, they think of you as nothing more than an entertainer, someone who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays a musical instrument well. They listen to what you say, but they do not do it.
When everything that you have prophesied happens, and it certainly will happen, then they will realize that a true prophet was living among them.”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, prophesy against the leaders of Israel, the men who should be caring for my people the way that shepherds care for their sheep. Say to these men who should be like shepherds that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Terrible things will happen to you leaders of Israel, because you have been taking care of only yourselves! You should be like shepherds who take care of their flocks.

{Instead, you use my people to enrich yourselves. It is as though} you eat the fat of the sheep and make your clothes from their wool and slaughter the healthiest animals, but you do not take care of the flock at all.

{It is as though} you have not strengthened the weak sheep. You have not healed the sick ones. You have not bandaged the injured ones. You have not brought back the ones that became scattered. You have not searched for the ones that got lost. Instead, you have ruled my people harshly and cruelly.

So my people scattered, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. Then their enemies attacked them and plundered them, as wild animals devour sheep that have no shepherd. So they scattered {more}.
My people wander like sheep over every mountain and on every high hill. They scatter all across the land, and no one at all searches {for them}.
Therefore, you leaders who should be shepherding my people, listen to what I, Yahweh, say:

I swear by my own life—this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare—that enemies have carried my people away as plunder and destroyed them as wild animals devour sheep because they had no shepherd. You who should have shepherded my people did not search for them. Instead, you fed only yourselves and did not take care of my people.
Therefore, you leaders who should be shepherding my people, listen to what I, Yahweh, say:

This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: I am now the enemy of you leaders! I will demand that you give my people back to me. I will remove you from taking care of them, so that you can no longer feed only yourselves. I will rescue my people from you, and you will never again plunder and destroy them as wild animals devour sheep.
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: Watch what I am about to do! I myself will search for my people, and I myself will take care of them.

Just as a shepherd takes care of his sheep when he is among his sheep that have scattered, so I will take care of my people. I will rescue them from every place where enemies scattered them during that terrible time.

I will bring my people out from the other peoples and gather them from the other lands, and I will bring them back to their own land. I will care for them like a shepherd on the mountains of Israel, alongside the streams, and in every place in the land where people live.

I will take care of them as a shepherd takes care of his sheep by giving them good pastures, and giving them a home on the high mountains of Israel. I will give them a good home in which to rest, and it will be as though they are feeding in rich pastures among the mountains of Israel.
I myself will take care of my people, and I myself will enable them to rest. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

I will search for the ones that got lost, and I will bring back the ones that enemies chased away. I will bandage the injured ones and strengthen the sick ones. However, I will destroy the fat and strong ones. Those, I will take care of justly.
As for you who are like my flock of sheep, this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: I am about to judge between each of you who are like sheep, and between each of you who are like rams and male goats.

You {powerful ones} are like strong animals that should be satisfied with feeding on the good pasture; and yet you also trample down the rest of the pasture with your feet. You should be satisfied with drinking the clear water; and yet you also muddy the rest of the water with your feet.
So {it is as though} the rest of my people are like the flock that must feed on the grass that you trampled and drink the water that you muddied.

Therefore, this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say to my flock: I myself am the one who is about to judge between those of you who are {strong like} fat sheep and those of you who are {weak like} thin sheep.

{It is as though} you are the powerful sheep who shove the weak sheep aside with your sides and your shoulders and gore all of them with your horns, until you have driven them away {from the pasture}.
I will rescue my people, and no one will ever plunder them again. I will judge between each one of my people.

I will appoint over them one leader who will care for them the way that a shepherd cares for his flock. He will be {a descendant of} my servant David. He himself will take care of my people, and he himself will be {as} their shepherd.
I, Yahweh, will be their God, and {that descendant of} my servant David will be the ruler among them. {This will surely happen because} I, Yahweh, have said this.

I will promise my people that they will live peacefully. I will remove every kind of dangerous animal from the land, so that my people can live safely {even} in the wilderness and sleep {safely} {even} in the forests.
I will bless my people and all of the land around my {sacred} hill. I will send rain at the proper times, and by that rain I will bless them.

The trees in the fields will produce their fruit, and the ground will produce its crops, and my people will live safely in their land. When I rescue them from the people who have caused them to be slaves, they will know that I, Yahweh, {have done this for them}.
The people of other nations will never plunder them again, and wild animals will no longer devour them. They will live safely, and there will be no one to frighten them.

I will make them famous for how securely I establish them in the land. They will never again need to leave the land because they lack food, and people of other nations will never again humiliate them.
Then they will know that I, Yahweh their God, am with them, and that they, the people of Israel, are my people. This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
You are my people, like a flock of sheep that I take care of in my own pasture. You are human beings, and I am your God. This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, turn toward Mount Seir {in the land of Edom} and prophesy against the people there.
Tell them, ‘This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: Listen, you people who live around Mount Seir! I am your enemy! I will punish you by turning your land into an empty wasteland where no one lives.
I will turn your cities into heaps of rubble, and as for your land, it will become empty. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

You have always hated the Israelites, and you delivered them over to soldiers who killed them with swords. You did that when terrible things were happening to them, at the time when I finally punished them for their sins.

Therefore, I swear by my own life— this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare—that I will deliver you over to people who will kill you, and killers will pursue you. {I swear that} because you hated the life of your kinsmen, killers will pursue you.
I will make the region of Mount Seir a completely desolate area. I will even destroy anyone who travels back and forth through it.

I will cover your mountains with the corpses of people whom your enemies will kill. Those whom soldiers kill with their swords will lie dead on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your stream beds.
I will make your land empty forever; no one will ever live in your cities again. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
You said that the two nations, {Israel and Judah,} and their two lands would belong to you, and that you would take possession of them. You said that even though I, Yahweh, was present there.

Therefore, I swear by my own life— this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare—that I will treat you {as harshly} as you treated my people when you were angry at them and envied them because you hated them. The Israelites will know who I am by how I judge you.

Then you will {also} know that I am Yahweh. I have heard all of the insulting things that you said about the land of Israel. You said that no one lived there anymore and that you could now take it and everything in it for yourselves.
You Edomites boasted arrogantly against me and said many things to insult me, and I myself heard all of it.
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: When I devastate your land, people all over the world will rejoice.

Just as you rejoiced when the land that I gave to the Israelites became desolate, I will do the same thing to you. Mount Seir and all the rest of Edom will become completely empty. Then people will know that I am Yahweh.’”
“ As for you, human, prophesy about the mountains in the land of Israel. Tell the Israelites to listen to this message from me, Yahweh, about the mountains of Israel!
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, Israel’s enemies gloated over them and claimed that these age-old mountains now belong to them.’

Because of that, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says: I say these things because the survivors from various nations all around greatly desired these mountains and they took possession of them. People everywhere gossiped about them and spread malicious reports about them.

Therefore, listen to what I, the Lord Yahweh, say about the mountains of Israel. I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking about the mountains and the hills, the ravines and the valleys, the ruins where no one lives any longer, and the cities that people abandoned, cities that survivors of the surrounding nations plundered and ridiculed.

Because of these things, I, the Lord Yahweh, say this: I swear that I am fiercely jealous {for what is mine} and that is why I have declared that I will punish the nations that have survived, and especially all the people of Edom. They joyfully and scornfully seized my land for themselves so that they could plunder its pastures.’

Therefore prophesy about the land of Israel. Say about the mountains and the hills, the ravines and the valleys, that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Listen! I have spoken because I am jealous and very angry, since the other nations have humiliated those who should possess them.
Therefore, I, myself, the Lord Yahweh, say this: I take a solemn oath and swear that I will humiliate those very nations that are around the land of Israel.
But the mountains of Israel will grow trees that produce plenty of fruit for my people Israel, because my people will soon come home.
Indeed, watch what I will do for Israel; I will bless the land. {Soon} people will plow its soil and plant seed in it.

I will greatly increase the number of people who live there. They will be all the people of Israel, every one of them. People will live in the cities again, and they will rebuild the broken buildings.

I will increase the number of people and animals there, and they will all have many offspring. I will cause people to live there as they did long ago, and I will make them more prosperous than they were at the beginning. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
I will cause my people Israel to go back and forth on the land. They will possess it, and it will belong to them permanently. Never again will they have to leave there.
I, the Lord Yahweh, say this: People are saying about the land of Israel that it destroys those who live there and that it loses its citizens.
Therefore, from now on, the land will not destroy the people who live there, or cause its citizens to leave there. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
Never again will I let the nations insult this land or the peoples revile it, and never again will this land fail the people of Israel. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, when the Israelite people were living in their own land, they made it a disgusting place by the way that they lived and by the things that they did. I considered the way that they behaved to be as repulsive as a filthy menstruation rag.
So I punished them severely, because they had murdered many people in the land and because they had made the land a disgusting place by worshiping idols there.
I scattered them among many nations and lands. I punished them for the {evil} way that they had lived and for the {evil} things that they had done.

Yet wherever they went among those nations, they caused people to think badly of me, the one who is holy. The people in those places said about them, ‘These people belong to Yahweh, and yet he was not able to keep them in his land.’
But I cared that people thought that I was not holy because the Israelite people had caused people to believe that among the nations wherever they went.

Therefore, tell the Israelite people that I, the Lord Yahweh, say this: ‘You Israelite people, I will do what I am about to do not because you deserve it. No, I will act in order to show people that I am the holy one, since you caused people to think that I am not powerfully holy among the nations wherever you went.

I will show that I am the powerful and holy one, rather than the one whom the people of the nations scorn because you caused them to think that I was profane {like you}. Then, when they see me show that I am powerfully holy by what I do for you, the people of those nations will know that I am Yahweh. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
I will take you out of those nations. I will gather you from all those lands and bring you back to your own land.

I will remove from you everything that made you unacceptable to me. I will cause you to stop worshiping all of your idols. It will be as though I sprinkled clean water on you and made you completely clean.
I will give to you a completely new way of thinking and a completely new attitude. I will cause you to stop being stubborn, and I will cause you to want to obey me.
I will put my Spirit within you and I will make it possible for you to live in the way that I have commanded and for you to carefully obey my instructions.
Then you will live in the land that I gave to your ancestors. You will be my people, and I myself will be your God.
I will rescue you from everything that made you unacceptable to me. I will make your grain grow plentifully, and I will never again cause you to lack food.
I will cause your fruit trees and your fields to produce plenty of food, so that the people of other nations will never again ridicule you because you do not have enough to eat.
Then you will think about how evil your behavior was and about the wicked things that you did, and you will hate yourselves because you sinned so much by doing those detestable things.

I want you to know that I will do these things, but not because you deserve for me to do them. I, the Lord Yahweh, declare this. You Israelite people should feel deep shame and disgrace because of the way that you have behaved!
I, the Lord Yahweh, say this: At the time when I forgive you all of your sins, I will cause people to live in your cities again, and they will rebuild the ruined places.
People will farm the land that was empty. It will no longer be desolate for everyone who passes by to see.

Then people will say, “This land was empty but now it has become {as fertile} as the garden of Eden, and the cities that enemies had ruined and torn down and left empty are now strong and full of people!”

Then the nations that I have allowed to remain around you will know that I, Yahweh, have enabled you to rebuild what enemies had torn down and to plant crops again where the land had been empty. I, Yahweh, have promised this, and I will do it.
I, the Lord Yahweh, say this: Once again I will respond when the Israelite people ask me to do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as a flock of sheep.

They will be like a flock of sheep that belong to Yahweh, like the flock of sheep that fills Jerusalem {when people bring them there to sacrifice} during the yearly festivals. The cities that are now in ruins will be full like that, but of people. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
Yahweh took hold of me, and by his Spirit he brought me out {from where I was} and set me down in the middle of a valley. This valley was full of {human} bones.
He led me all around among the bones. I saw that there were a huge number of bones lying on the ground all through the valley, and I saw that they were completely dry.
He asked me, “Human, can these bones become alive again?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, only you know that.”
Then he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones. Say to them, ‘You dry bones, listen to this message from Yahweh!’
Tell these bones that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say to them: ‘Watch this! I am going to cause breath to enter you, and you will become alive again.
I will attach tendons to you, and I will cause flesh to grow on you, and I will cover you with skin. I will put breath in you, and you will become alive again. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

So I prophesied just what Yahweh had commanded me {to say}. While I was prophesying, I heard a noise, and I realized that it was the rattling of the bones coming together, each bone joining to the bone that belonged next to it!
As I watched, I saw tendons appear on the bones, and then flesh grew on them, and then skin covered over the surface of them. However, they were not breathing.

Then he said to me, “Human, prophesy to the breath. Tell the breath that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Breath, come from every direction and enter into these dead people, so that they may become alive again.’”
So I prophesied just what he had commanded me {to say}, and breath entered them. They became alive and stood up on their feet, and became a vast, enormous army.

Then he said to me, “Human, these bones represent all the people of Israel. Listen; they keep saying that they have lost all of their strength, that they have nothing left to hope for, and that they have ended as a nation.

So prophesy and tell them that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘Listen carefully to this, my people: {It will be as though} I will open your graves and bring you up out of them {and make you live again} when I bring you back to the land of Israel.
When {it is as though} I am opening your graves and bringing you up out of them, then you my people will know that I am Yahweh.

I will put my Spirit in you, and {it will be as though} you will become alive again, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am the one who has promised this and that I am the one who has done it. That is what I, Yahweh, declare.’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Now you human, get a shaft of wood and write on it, ‘This represents Judah and the Israelite tribes that belong with Judah.’ Then get another shaft of wood and write on it, ‘This represents the Israelite tribes associated with Joseph, that is, it is the shaft of the tribe of Ephraim, and all of the Israelite tribes that belong with Ephraim.’
Then align the two pieces of wood with each other as one piece of wood so that they become like one shaft of wood in your hand.
When your fellow Israelites ask you to explain to them what you mean by doing this,

tell them that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘Listen well! I am going to take the piece of wood that represents Joseph, the part of Israel that the tribe of Ephraim controls, along with the Israelite tribes that belong with Ephraim. I will take them together, and then I will join them to the piece of wood that represents Judah. I will make them to be one piece of wood, and I will hold them as one piece of wood in my hand.’
{As you say this,} hold in your hand the pieces of wood on which you wrote, where your fellow Israelites can see them.

Then tell them that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Listen well! I am going to take the Israelite people out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from every direction and bring them back to their own land.

I will make them to be one nation in that land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will rule over all of them. They will not be two nations any more, and they will never again separate into two kingdoms.

They will no longer make themselves unacceptable to me by {worshiping} their idols and their disgusting images, or by their many ways of rebelling against me. I will rescue them from all the places where they have been living and sinning, and I will forgive them for sinning. They will be my people, and I myself will be their God.

{A descendant of} my servant David will be their king, and he alone will rule over all of them, taking care of them as a shepherd takes care of his flock. They will live in the way that I have said is right, and they will carefully obey all of my laws.

They will live in the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where their ancestors lived. They and their children and their grandchildren will live there forever, and {the one who is the descendant of} my servant David will be their ruler forever.

I will make an agreement with them that will make a peaceful relationship possible between us; it will be an agreement that lasts forever for them. I will establish them {in that land} and cause them to become very numerous, and I will put my temple among them forever.
I will live among them; I will be their God, and they themselves will be my people.
When my holy dwelling place is among the Israelite people forever, then the other nations will know that I, Yahweh, am the one who makes Israel holy.’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said to me,
“Human, turn toward Gog, who is from the land of Magog and who is the most important ruler over the regions of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
Tell him that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Gog, you who are the most important ruler over Meshech and Tubal, be aware that I am your enemy!

I will turn you around and {force you to go wherever I want you to go, as though I had} put hooks in your jaws. I will bring you out {for battle}, you and your whole army, your horses and the men who ride them. All of them will be wearing full armor, a huge crowd of men carrying both large shields and small shields. Every one of them is skillful at using his sword.
Soldiers from Persia, Cush, and Put will go along with your army, and all of them will carry shields and wear helmets.

The army of Gomer with all of its many soldiers will go with you, and so will the army of Beth Togarmah, which lies in the far north, with all of its groups of soldiers. {The armies from} many nations will go with you.
Get ready! Prepare yourself well, you and all the troops that you have gathered around you, and be ready to command them.

A long time from now I will summon you for battle. After many years have passed, you will attack a land where the people have recovered from war. They are the people whom I will have gathered from many nations and settled again all through the land of Israel, which has been in ruins for a very long time. Those are the very people whom I will have brought out from among the nations, and all of them will be living there peacefully.
You will advance {as suddenly and violently} as a storm. Your troops and the many peoples who come with you {will be so many that they} will spread like a cloud over the whole land.
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say will happen: At that time, you will think about doing something evil, and you will make a plan to do it.

You will say {to yourself}, “{With my army} I will attack {the people of} this land whose villages have no walls around them. I will attack people who are living quietly and who feel secure, all of them living in places that have no walls, no gates, and no bars.

I will take away everything valuable that they own. I will attack the towns that soldiers had destroyed but where people are living once again. I will attack these people who have come back from many nations and who have acquired livestock and other possessions. I will attack these people who live at this significant place in the world.”

The people of Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and its bold traders will say to you, “You are certainly coming in order to steal everything valuable. You have certainly gathered your army together in order to carry off silver and gold, to seize livestock and other possessions, and to take away a huge amount of goods.”’
So then human, prophesy to Gog. Say to him that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘At that time, when my people Israel are living peacefully, you will certainly notice it.
Then you will come from your home in the far north, and many peoples will come with you. They will be an enormous army, and all of them will be riding horses.

Your army will attack my people Israel, and your soldiers {will be so many that they} will spread over the whole land like a cloud. This will happen in a far future time. Gog, I will bring you to attack my land so that the nations will come to know me. They will watch what I do to you, and in that way I will show them that I am holy.’

This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Do not think that you are the person about whom I spoke long ago through my servants, the prophets of Israel, when for many years during that time they prophesied that I would bring someone to attack the people of Israel.
No, what will happen at the time when you, Gog, step onto the ground belonging to Israel, is this: I will become furious. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
Because I am fiercely protective of my people and because I am extremely angry, I solemnly promise that at that time there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the wild animals, every creature that crawls on the ground, and every person living on the earth will tremble before me. Mountains will fall down, cliffs will collapse, and walls everywhere will fall to the ground.
I will make men fight against you, Gog, on all my mountains. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. Every one of your soldiers will attack his fellow soldier with his sword.

I will punish you by causing a deadly disease among you and by causing many people to die violently. I will send heavy rain, hailstones, fire, and burning sulfur down on you and on your troops and on the many peoples who are with you.

In that way I will show that I am great and that I am holy, and people of many nations will come to know who I am as they watch. They will acknowledge that I am Yahweh{, the one who has power over everything}.’”

{Yahweh also said to me,} “Now you human, prophesy against Gog. Tell him that this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: ‘Gog, you who are the most important ruler over Meshech and Tubal, be aware that I am your enemy!
I will turn you around and drive you along. I will bring you up from the far north, and I will send you {to fight} on the mountains of Israel.
Then I will knock your bow out of your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.

You and all of your troops and all of the peoples who come with you will die on the mountains of Israel. I will give your dead bodies as food to birds of every kind that feed on flesh and to the wild animals.
You will die out in the open country, because I myself have said {that it will happen}. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
I will cause fires to burn throughout the land of Magog and among the people who live in the lands along the seacoasts and who think that they are safe there. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

I will clearly display that I am the powerfully holy one among my people Israel, and I will never again allow people {to have any reason} to say that I am not powerfully holy. Then the people of other nations will know that I am Yahweh, the holy one who lives among the people of Israel.
Mark my words, the time when these things will happen is certainly coming. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. It is the time that I have spoken {to you} about.

Then the people who live in the cities of Israel will go out, gather up the weapons, and burn them. They will burn the small shields and the large shields, the bows and the arrows, the clubs that soldiers carry in their hands, and the spears. They will use those weapons to make fires for seven years.

They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut wood in the forests, because they will make their fires with those weapons. They will actually be taking plunder from the people who came to plunder them! That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

At that time I will give Gog a place in Israel; it will be his grave, in the Valley of the Travelers, which is east of the sea. That grave will block the people who travel through it. There the people will bury Gog and the whole crowd of soldiers who came with him, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon Gog.
For seven months the people of Israel will be burying those dead bodies, so that the dead bodies will no longer defile the land {by remaining unburied}.

All of the people of the land {of Israel} will {work together to} bury them, and doing that will cause people to honor them. At that time everyone will see how glorious I am. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

At the end of the seven months, the people will appoint men to continue to work at this task. Those men will travel through the land searching for and burying the bodies of the invaders that still lie on the ground, in order to make the land acceptable to me again.

As those men travel through the land, whenever any one of them sees a human bone, he will set up a marker beside it. When the gravediggers see the markers, they will pick up the bones and bury them in the Valley of Hamon Gog.’
(There is also a city named Hamonah.) ‘In this way the people will make the land acceptable to me again.’

This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say to you human: Call out to every kind of bird and to every wild animal. Say to them, ‘Gather yourselves together from everywhere and come to the feast that Yahweh is preparing for you. He will slaughter a great many people on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat {men’s} flesh and drink their blood.

You will eat the flesh of mighty soldiers, and you will drink the blood of the rulers of the nations. {Yahweh will slaughter them as though they were the} rams and lambs and goats and bulls {that people sacrifice}, all of them {like} the well-fed animals from {the region of} Bashan.
At the sacrifice that Yahweh is preparing for you, you will eat fat until you are completely full, and you will drink blood until you can drink no more.

{It will be as though} you are eating at a table that I have prepared for you. You will eat all you want {of the flesh} of horses and of the men who ride them, of mighty soldiers and of every kind of fighting man. {That is what I,} the Lord Yahweh, declare.’
I will show the {people of many} nations how glorious I am, and all of those people will see how I have justly punished them.
Starting at that time and then always afterward, the people of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God.

The {people of many} nations will also know that I banished the people of Israel from their land because they sinned, that is, they acted unfaithfully toward me. So I refused to help them and instead let their enemies capture them and kill very many of them.
I punished them in the way that they deserved, because they had become disgusting to me and had rebelled against me. So I refused to help them.

Therefore this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say: Now I will make the descendants of Jacob prosperous again, and I will act mercifully toward all of the people of Israel. I will work passionately to keep anyone from having a reason to say that I am not {powerfully} holy.

When the people of Israel are living safely in their own land with no one making them afraid, then they will feel ashamed of the disgraceful things that they did {previously} and of all of the ways that they had acted unfaithfully toward me.

I will gather them from among the other peoples and bring them back from the lands of their enemies {to their own land}. When I do that for them, then the people of many nations will understand that I am {powerfully} holy.

Then the people of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations and I will gather them back into their own land again. I will not leave any of them in those nations any longer.
I will never again refuse to help them after I generously give my Spirit to the people of Israel. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.”

It was 24 years after {the Babylonians} forcibly removed us Israelites from our land. It was 13 years after {the Babylonians} conquered the city of Jerusalem. It was the tenth day of the first month. On that day, Yahweh acted powerfully toward me and took me somewhere.

God did this in something like a dream. He took me to the area where the Israelites lived and had me stand on a very tall mountain. On the south side of the mountain were buildings that together looked like a city.
Then Yahweh took me to those buildings. There, I saw a man! He was standing at an entrance, and he shone like bronze. He was holding a linen rope and a stick for measuring things.

The man told me, “Human, God took you to this place so that you would learn things. So, you must look at, listen to, and think carefully about everything that I will show you. Later, you must tell the Israelites everything that you learned.”

Now the stick that the man was holding was for measuring things using longer measurements than normal. It was about 3.2 meters long. Then I saw a wall that went all the way around the area where the {temple} building was. The man used the stick to measure the wall. It was 3.2 meters thick and 3.2 meters tall.
Then the man went to the gatehouse on the east side {of the wall} and climbed up its stairs. He measured the threshold. It was 3.2 meters deep.

{Inside the gatehouse}, there were small side rooms. They were 2.7 meters apart. Each side room was 3.2 meters deep and 3.2 meters wide. Where the gatehouse opened toward the {temple} building, there was an entryway. Inside the entryway, there was a threshold. It was 3.2 meters deep.
The man measured the entryway where the gatehouse opened toward the {temple} building.
It was 4.3 meters deep. The walls around its opening were 1.1 meters deep. {That was what the man measured} for the entryway where the gatehouse opened toward the {temple} building.
Inside the gatehouse on the east side, there were three small side rooms on each side {of the hallway}. Each of them was the same size. The walls around each of their openings were the same size.
The man measured the open space for the gatehouse’s door. It was 5.4 meters wide. The gatehouse’s hallway was seven meters wide.
In front of each small side room, there was a half wall. Each half wall was 54 centimeters {wide}, and each small side room was 3.2 meters {on each side}.
Then the man measured along the top of the gatehouse from the back of one small side room to the back of the small side room on the other side {of the hallway}. It was 13.5 meters wide.
He measured all the walls around the gatehouse’s openings, ending at the walls around the opening to the courtyard. They were 32.4 meters high.
{He measured} from the front of the gatehouse, where people entered, to the end of the entryway on the inside. It was 27 meters.

There were niches on the inside of the small side rooms, on the walls around their openings, and in the entryway all around the inside of the gatehouse. Carvings of palm trees were on the walls around the gatehouse’s openings.

Then the man had me walk into the courtyard that was between the outer wall and the inner wall. I saw stone flooring all the way around {the inside of the outer wall}. I also saw 30 rooms. {Their back walls were the outer wall,} and they opened {to the inside} onto the stone flooring.
The stone flooring stretched out into the courtyard as far as each of the gatehouses did. This flooring was lower {than the courtyard inside the inner wall}.

The man measured from the inner side of the gatehouse {in the outer wall} that was lower {than the courtyard inside the inner wall}. He measured to the outside of {the gate that led to} the courtyard that was inside the inner wall. It was 54 meters long. {That was what the man measured for the gatehouse on} the east {side}. {Then, we went to the gatehouse on} the north {side}.
He measured the gatehouse on the north side of the outer wall. He measured how deep and how long it was.

It had three small side rooms on each side {of the hallway}, walls around its openings, and entryway. They were all exactly the same size as the ones in the gatehouse on the eastern side. The gatehouse was 27 meters long and 13.5 meters wide.

It had niches, an entryway, and carvings of palm trees. They were all exactly the same size as the ones in the gatehouse on the eastern side. People had to walk up seven steps to enter the gatehouse. When they did, the entryway was directly in front of them.

Just as there was on the east side, on the north side there was a gatehouse through the inner wall in line with the outer gatehouse. The man measured from this inner gate to the gate through the outer wall on the north side. It was 54 meters.

Then, the man had me walk to the south side {of the courtyard}. There, I saw the gatehouse on the south side {of the wall}. He measured the walls around its openings and its entryway. They were the same size as the ones in the other gatehouses.
There were niches all around the inside of the gatehouse and its entryway. They were the same as the niches in the other gatehouses. This gatehouse was 27 meters long and 13.5 meters wide.
People had to walk up seven steps to enter the gatehouse. When they did, the entryway was directly in front of them. On each of the walls around its openings there were carvings of palm trees.
On the south side there was a gatehouse through the inner wall. The man measured from this inner gate to the gate through the outer wall on the south side. It was 54 meters.

Then the man had me walk into the courtyard that was inside the inner wall. We went through the gatehouse on the south side {of the inner wall}. He measured that gatehouse. It was exactly the same size as the other gatehouses.

It had small side rooms, walls around its openings, and an entryway. They were exactly the same size as the ones in the other gatehouses. There were niches all around the inside of the gatehouse and its entryway. The gatehouse was 27 meters long and 13.5 meters wide.
The entryways to each of the gates through the inner wall were 13.5 meters long and 2.7 meters wide.
The south gatehouse’s entryway opened to the courtyard between the inner and outer walls. Carvings of palm trees were on the walls around its openings. People had to walk up eight steps to enter it.
Then the man had me walk to the east side of the courtyard that was inside the inner wall. He measured the gatehouse there. It was exactly the same size as the other gatehouses.

It had small side rooms, walls around its openings, and an entryway. They were exactly the same size as the ones in the other gatehouses. There were niches all around the inside of the gatehouse and its entryway. The gatehouse was 27 meters long and 13.5 meters wide.
Its entryway opened to the courtyard between the inner and outer walls. Carvings of palm trees were on each of the walls around its openings. People had to walk up eight steps to enter it.
Then the man had me walk to the gatehouse on the north side {of the inner wall}. He measured it. It was exactly the same size as the other gatehouses.
It had small side rooms, walls around its openings, and an entryway. There were niches all around the inside of the gatehouse. The gatehouse was 27 meters long and 13.5 meters wide.
Its entryway opened to the courtyard between the inner and outer walls. Carvings of palm trees were on each of the walls around its openings. People had to walk up eight steps to enter it.
There was a room next to each inner gatehouse. Each had a door that opened into the entryway of that gatehouse. That was where people washed their wholly burned sacrifices.

Inside the north gatehouse’s entryway, there were two tables on each side {of the hallway}. People killed the animals for their wholly burned sacrifices, purifying sacrifices, and restoring sacrifices on those tables.
Outside the north gatehouse’s entryway, next to its front walls, there were two tables on each side of the steps that went up to the entryway.
So, there were four tables on each side of the gatehouse. People killed animals for sacrifices on those eight tables.

Someone had shaped stones to make the four tables {inside the gatehouse} on which people killed their wholly burned sacrifices. Each table was 81 centimeters long, 81 centimeters wide, and 54 centimeters tall. People put on these tables the tools they used to kill the wholly burned sacrifices and any other kind of sacrifice.
People also put on those tables the meat from their sacrifices. There were ledges {on the inside walls} of the {entryway} structure all around. Each ledge was 8 centimeters deep.

Within the courtyard that was inside the inner wall and its gatehouses, there were two rooms. One room was next to the north gatehouse. Its door opened to the south. The other room was next to the east gatehouse. Its door opened to the north.
The man told me, “The room whose doors open to the south is for the priests who guard the {temple} building.
The room whose doors open to the north is for the priests who guard the altar. All those priests are descendants of Zadok. They are the only Levites who can approach Yahweh to serve him.”
Then he measured the courtyard {inside the inner walls}. It was square, 54 meters long on each side. There was an altar in front of the {temple} building.

Then the man had me walk into the {temple} building’s entryway. He measured the walls around the gateway opening. They were 2.7 meters thick on each side. The gateway opening was 7.6 meters across. The front walls that spanned from the gateway to the side walls were 1.6 meters wide on each side.
The entryway was 10.8 meters wide and 6.5 meters deep. People had to walk up stairs to enter it. There were two large posts {just outside} the walls around the entryway’s opening, one on each side.
Then the man had me walk into the Holy Place. He measured the walls around its opening. They were 3.2 meters thick on each side.

The opening into the Holy Place was 5.4 meters across. The walls that spanned from the opening to the side walls were 2.7 meters wide on each side. Then the man measured the Holy Place. It was 21.6 meters long and 10.8 meters wide.

Then the man went into the inner room. He measured the walls around its opening. They were 1.1 meters thick. The opening into the room was 3.2 meters across. {The walls that spanned} from the opening {to the side walls} were 3.8 meters wide {on each side}.
He measured that inner room, which was at the far end of the Holy Place. It was 10.8 meters long and 10.8 meters wide. He told me, “This room is the Most Holy Place.”

Then the man measured the wall for the temple building. It was 3.2 meters thick. There were rooms along the outside of the temple building’s wall on its {north, south, and west} sides. Each of these side rooms was 2.2 meters wide.

There were 30 side rooms around the temple building, and each one had two more side rooms directly above it. There were ledges all around the temple building’s wall to support these rooms. That way, the temple building wall itself did not support these rooms.

The side rooms were deeper at the top than at the bottom all around the temple building. So, the outside of the temple building was wider at the top than at the bottom. There were steps that went around and up {the inside of the front side rooms}. That way, people could walk up to the highest room from the lowest room through the middle room.
I noticed that the temple building stood on a platform on all sides. The part of the platform that the side rooms stood on was 3.2 meters {high}.
The outer wall for the side rooms was 2.7 meters thick. Outside the side rooms that were along the outer wall of the temple building, between them
and the rooms {that were further away from the temple building}, there was an open space 10.8 meters wide around the whole temple building.

There were two doorways into the side rooms. One faced north and one faced south. They opened into an open space at the edge of the platform. This open space was 2.7 meters wide all around {the temple building}.

On the west side of the courtyard {that went around the temple building}, there was another building. Its wall was 2.7 meters thick all the way around. {The inside} of the building was 38 meters east to west and 49 meters north to south.

Then the man measured the temple building from east to west. It was 54 meters long. He measured the courtyard {on the western side of the temple building}, the other building, and the other building’s walls from east to west. In total, they were 54 meters long.
The courtyard on the east side of the temple building was 54 meters from north to south.
The man measured the other building, the one that was on the west side of the western courtyard. He included its decorative shelves on each side. It was 54 meters from north to south.

those three rooms all had thresholds, niches, and decorative shelves all around. Starting at the threshold, there were long, thin pieces of wood covering the walls, niches, and decorative shelves all around, from the floor to the niches. The niches had coverings over their openings.

The long, thin pieces of wood covered everything from above the entrance into the temple building to the Most Holy Place. They covered all the walls, inside and outside the temple building, all the way around. Each piece of wood was exactly the same size.
Workmen had carved winged creatures and palm trees on the pieces of wood. There was always one palm tree between two winged creatures. Each winged creature had two faces.
A human face looked toward the palm tree on one side. A lion’s face looked toward the palm tree on the other side. Workmen had carved this pattern on the walls all around the temple building.
From the floor to the top of the entrance, including the walls of the Holy Place, workmen had carved the winged creatures and palm trees.
The sides of the door frame into the Holy Place had faces at right angles to each other. The door frames into the Most Holy Place were exactly the same as those.

{In the Holy Place,} there was a wooden altar. It was 1.6 meters high and 1.1 meters long {and wide}. Its corner pieces, base, and sides were wooden. Then the man told me, “This is a table. It is in Yahweh’s presence.”
The entrance into Holy Place and the entrance into the Most Holy Place each had two sets of doors.
Each of the two sets of doors {at each entrance} had two panels that swung on hinges.

Workmen had carved winged creatures and palm trees on the sets of doors into the Holy Place. They were just like the carvings on the temple building’s walls. There was a wooden covering over the area just outside the entryway {into the temple building}.
On the two walls that spanned from the entryway opening to its sidewalls, there were niches and carvings of palm trees. The rooms on the outside of the temple building also had coverings.

Then the man had me walk out into the courtyard that was between the inner and outer walls. We went through {the gate} on the north side of the inner walls. He led me to some rooms. These rooms were next to the courtyard and building that were on the west side of the temple building. The rooms were on the north side of that courtyard and building.
All together, those rooms were 54 meters from east to west and 27 meters from north to south. There was an entrance on their north side.

The courtyard that was 10.8 meters wide to the west of the temple building was on the southeast side of those rooms. The stone flooring around the inside of the outer walls was on the northwest side of those rooms. The outside of the rooms had two decorative shelves that divided them into three stories.
On the north side of the rooms, there was a walkway 5.4 meters wide and 54 meters long. The rooms’ doors opened on the north side.

The rooms on the third story were narrower {north to south than the rooms on the lower stories}. That is because the decorative shelves above the first and second stories used space {that would have been part of the rooms on the floor above}.

So, there were three stories of rooms. However, although the rest of the rooms in both courtyards had large posts, these rooms did not. Because of that, the highest story was narrower than the middle story, which was narrower than the lowest story.
Along the north side of the rooms, {at the north edge of the walkway,} there was a low wall. It was 27 meters long from east to west.

{That low wall was only 27 meters long} because the rooms along the outer wall were 27 meters deep. So, {the length of the room next to the western outer wall and the length of the low wall added up to} the length of these rooms that were nearer to the Holy Place. They were 54 meters long.
On the ground floor of these rooms, there was an entryway on the eastern side. A person could enter from the courtyard between the inner and outer walls

There was a walkway on the {south} side of those rooms, just like the one on the {north side of} the northern rooms. They were exactly the same size as the northern rooms, and they had the same measurements, exits, and entrances.

Those rooms had entrances that opened to the south. The entrance to the walkway was like those entrances. A person could enter it at the eastern end of the walkway and the low wall {that was on the south side of the walkway}.

Then the man told me, “The northern and southern rooms that are next to the courtyard {to the west of the temple building} are sacred. Because they are sacred, the priests who approach Yahweh set the most sacred offerings there, including grain offerings, purifying offerings, and restoring sacrifices. They also eat the most sacred offerings there.

Now the clothes that the priests wear when they are serving as priests in sacred areas are also sacred. So, when the priests are ready to leave those sacred areas, they must first leave their clothes in the rooms {to the north or the south of the temple building}. When they have changed into other clothes, they can go into the courtyard between the inner and outer walls and to where the rest of the people are.”

The man had now completed measuring everything inside the temple area. Next, he had me walk outside the temple area through the gatehouse on the east side. Then, he measured the area all around the outside.
He measured the east side with the stick for measuring things. It was 270 meters long.
He measured the north side with the stick for measuring things. It was 270 meters long.
He measured the south side with the stick for measuring things. It was 270 meters long.
Then he went to the west side and measured it with the stick for measuring things. It was 270 meters long.

{In summary,} the man measured the temple area on all four sides. There was a wall all the way around it, and it was 270 meters long on each side. This wall divided the sacred area from the ordinary area {outside it}.
After that, the man had me walk to the gatehouse that went through the {outer} eastern wall.

Then I saw where the God whom we Israelites worship was making himself gloriously present! It was like a very bright light, which lit up the ground around it. It was as loud as crashing waves. It was moving from the east toward us.

What I saw looked exactly like what I saw previously when God arrived to destroy Jerusalem. It also looked exactly like what I saw previously when I was at the Kebar River. So, I {fearfully and respectfully} bowed with my face to the ground.
The place where Yahweh made himself gloriously present went through the gatehouses on the east side of the temple area. It arrived at the temple building.
Then {Yahweh sent} a wind {that} picked me up and set me back down in the courtyard inside the inner walls. Then I saw that Yahweh had made himself gloriously present throughout the temple building.
The man {who had measured everything} was standing next to me. Then I heard someone inside the temple building speaking to me.

That person told me, “Human, this is where I will rule as king. I will make myself present here with the Israelites forever. The Israelite people and their kings will no longer cause people to dishonor my holy self. They used to do that when they worshiped other gods, performed rituals to appease their dead kings at the high places,
and built houses against the temple walls. They did disgusting things, which made people dishonor my holy self. So, I was angry with them and destroyed them.
At this time, they must stop worshiping other gods and performing rituals to appease their dead kings. Then, I will make myself present here with them forever.
As for you, human, describe the temple area to the Israelites. That will shame them for what they have done wrong. Have them study carefully how I have designed it.

Suppose that everything {wrong} that they have done does shame them. In that case, tell them about the design of the temple building and where everything in it is. Tell them about its exits and entryways. Tell them about the rules and instructions for it. Write it all down for them. Then, they must do everything that I have instructed them to do.
Listen to this very important instruction concerning the temple building. The area all around the top of this mountain is very sacred.

Here is what the altar’s parts measure, using longer measurements than normal. Each unit of measure is 54 centimeters long. There is a gutter {around the base of the altar}. It is 54 centimeters deep and 54 centimeters across. There is a rim all around {the outside of} the gutter. It is 23 centimeters high. What follows are the parts that make up the altar’s bottom part.

There are side walls from the bottom of the gutter to a ledge 1.1 meters above the ground. The ledge is 54 centimeters deep. There are more side walls from this lower ledge to a higher ledge 2.2 meters above the lower ledge. This higher ledge is also 54 centimeters deep.
The flat area for burning things is 2.2 meters {above the higher ledge}. There are four projections upward, {one from each of the four corners} of the flat area.
The flat area for burning things has corners that are right angles. Each side is 6.5 meters long.
